body:
notes on <事实与偏见>

有好老板才有好伙计

-   上层直接参与非常重要

怎样当个好主管

-   用自己真的面孔和感受去面对下属，慢慢你就会赢到下属对你真正的尊敬。

-   不敢承担责任的主管，不是太过谨慎，缺乏进取，就是处处怕错，事事畏首畏尾， 因而令部门的工作没法开展

    -   同样，一个对别人抱着轻易否定态度的主管，不肯信任下属，事无大小都要插手去管，令员工没有发挥余地，变成了主管的办事工具

-   主要考虑他的性格和修养； 他是否自信，乐观，做人是否积极

    -   自信，乐观的主管办事不会怕出错。 他们敢承担，他们敢去闯，因而大大提高业务发展的机会，连带也提高员工的发展和晋升机会；
        当他们感觉到是会有发展的机会时，员工对工作就会更投入，办事效果也会更好 ，员工的士气也因此而提高

    -   积极待人的主管，会信任员工，给予员工更大的责任和权力，让他们有更多学习和发展的机会，使他们成长。
        用相互信任和沟通的办法，可以精简制度，减少员工面对的制肘，给他们更大的发挥空间。 当员工受到重用，他们对主管的信任也大大增加，
        由于彼此合作无间，部门运作的效率也就会大大地提高

notes on <事实与偏见>

虚伪，但有益

-   为了追求所渴望的目标，我们都要压抑自然的欲望和言行，以便适应客观环境需要

    -   我们可称之为“虚伪 ”， 因为它不是出于我们自然的感觉和反应

    -   假如我们都不虚伪，任由一己自然的欲望为所欲为，整个社会将变得混乱和难以容忍

    -   为了跟别人和平共存，我们都惯常地做一些本来不会做，不想做的事。 即使做了，也尽量表现给别人看是乐意而为。
        因为看来愈乐意，别人就愈容易接受我们，也使我们愈容易达到目的。

-   很多伟大的事业，都是用一份真挚的感情，去做虚伪但对其他人有益的事

notes on <学做个快乐人>

学习欣赏老婆

-   我对她认识愈深，便发现她愈多新的一面，也就愈加改变对将来的她的想象。

找生意拍档之道

-   尖酸刻薄，爱钱如命的孤寒鬼

    -   他们只会整天盘算怎样榨取对方的钱，而从来不会设想如何替对方创造价值。 拿对方视为斗争对象。

    -   一有机会便必定要舍他们而去

-   不惜为事业牺牲家庭儿女的人

    -   必定心胸狭窄，见利忘义， 一有机会，他们便会一脚把伙伴踢开

    -   这些人只追逐功利，不求幸福，他们心中只有恨没有爱，只要赢不懂输；生意偶一失利，他们便会设法脱身而逃，哪怕陷伙伴于不义亦在所不惜。

-   将市场当赌博的人

    -   他们做生意只是为了碰运气，想一铺发达

-   好大喜功的梦想家

    -   以为在脑袋有个概念一切便水到渠成了； 只有计划而没有执行能力

-   懒人
    -   懒人必蠢， 聪明人脑袋不断地转，他们看得出做生意的现实需要，故次要懒也懒不来

做好本份是最有效的应酬

-   生意是以利益来维系的

    -   利益关系来得有多密切，是和生意效益的大小成正比例的

-   只消把工作做好，别人需要你，你的人缘自然便会好起来

学会从困难中成长

-   解决问题是一个学习，成长的过程

    -   学懂了专注关键问题，放权给手下

    -   以耐性，毅力和谦卑服人，权力才会有效， 否则手下不服气

营业员的责任是替顾客赚钱

-   营业员卖的是解决方案而不是货品

    -   客人是你的生意伙伴，你赚钱的保障， 不是替你完成销量指标的手段

-   无论客人做什么生意，他最终目的永远是降低成本，提高利润

    -   客人向我要的是解决困难的方法，不是货品。
        这些方法愈是简单，容易，便宜便愈好。

-   弄清目标，去见客之前，我会先了解他的困难是什么
    -   我不单止是他的供应商，更是替他赚钱的生意伙伴

管理是从驾驭权力开始

-   权力是领导和团结的力量，不是要别人低头的图腾

    -   他们关心的只是伴随权力而来的责任

-   懂得驾驭权力

    -   会关心如何让别人更投入工作，如何争取别人的支持。
        要是得不到支持，他们会检讨是不是自己做错了什么。
        真的做错了，他们会努力推销自己的想法。 委实推销不来，他们会拿出胸襟和耐性，把事情搁置下来，而不是持权压下去。

    -   不被运用的权力才会发挥最大的效用，因为它没有摄人的杀伤力，却反而给人安全感，令人乐于趋附。

沟通是为了找出问题

-   管理是沟通

    -   大家提出意见，简化复杂的问题，达成清晰明确，每个人都主观认同的共识。这么一来大家能迅速配合，调节工作，提高效率。

-   管理人沟通的首要目的是找出问题的核心，达成共识，然后集中资源寻找解决问题的方案

    -   开会的目的， 是确定哪些是要解决的核心问题？ 症结在哪里？
        有了这个共识，大家便可以回到各自的岗位去着手解决问题了。

    -   开会的另一目的，是将达成的共识变成每个人的主观意识。 这个是buy-in 解决方案的过程。

    -   有了大家都接纳的信念，那么回到各自的岗位上去，按实际情况，透过尝试与失败的摸索调节方案，便可以快捷，顺利地解决问题了。

学习在耻辱中成长

-   坚毅的性格可以令一个人顶天立地

    -   谦卑是坚毅的先决条件

    -   面对困难和耻辱（奚落或挫折）， 才可以不断进步， 不断创造

学做人， 不是学做事

-   做人只要抓紧是非准则，便不妨给自己多些机会，多做尝试

    -   万勿害怕犯错，只要有知错能改的勇气，工作便自然得心应手，最后便会心想事成了

    -   让心窝最深处的感觉告诉你是否真的要做这个事情； 真的要做，便去做好了。 到有一天你心疲力倦，做不来了，那么你总算知道自己的心没有搞错，只是力不从心罢了。

    -   做事要随心所欲，放下顾虑，什么也不想，放胆去做

    -   守得住是非好坏这一关，你便知对错，便不断有教训，不断有进步，那么迟早你也会事业有成的

        -   价值观

    -   要是能够抽离是非， 有了事实才下判断， 是非是明显不过的

        -   灵肉分离

    -   只有透过不同人的批判才能发现客观事实，找到事实真相

学习减少痛苦

-   没有痛苦的历练就没有快乐的体验

    -   没有真实生活的考验，人也就不会成熟，不会有坚强的性格

-   追求理想和解决问题是两回事

    -   理想是脱离现实设造出来的，解决问题则是从小处入手逐一克服困难的程序

    -   理想令我们抛离现实，可是做人做事最大的责任确是解决问题。
        人生是不完美的，是充满了意想不到的问题的。 不实实在在解决问题， 我们便会在牛角尖里死钻。

-   人生在世，我们都只能减少痛苦，而不能追求快乐
    -   我们知道什么东西会带来痛苦，尽量避开，从而给自己留下了快乐的空间。 只要习惯从负面去思考问题，正面的事情便应运而生了。

学习放下仇恨

-   仇恨纯粹是消耗

    -   爱有所得， 仇恨却只会带来痛苦

    -   仇恨是自我毁灭的循环，一场没有赢家的游戏

-   仇恨是个恶性循环的自我苦难游戏

    -   只有我们自己才感受到这个仇恨，被我们仇恨的人是感受不
    -   对别人的仇恨一点是仇恨自己的化身

-   仇恨的最大敌人是时间和人性宽恕的特性
    -   时间一过，起初的愤恨泄了，我们便再仇恨不起来
    -   时过境迁，感恩宽恕之心油然而生。一旦宽恕了，便再难提得起仇恨的执着

学习分辨是非黑白

-   是人的价值观令事情有了好坏之分。 事实是没有是非的。

    -   人们通常都不根究事实，只是关心事情的对错。 人都不能摆脱固有的立场和是非观来看世间事情
    -   只有透过不同人的批判才能发现客观的事实，找到事实的真相

-   对人而言，价值信念比事实更重要
    -   人是为信念真理，而不是事实而活的
-   只要不违法和违背社会公益，任何商业机构都会追求最高利润，都以赢为共同价值观

    -   在同一环境，机构共事的人却不该有不同的价值观

-   是非不分，往往是因为我们都先有了是非准则才去看事实

    -   要是能够抽离是非，有了事实才下判断，是非是明显不过的

    -   人难免受个人主观左右，看不到事实的整体。 故此只有透过不同的人的批判才能发现客观的事实，找到事实的真相

-   真理的基础是事实，真理的意义是对错

notes on <创业>

TODO

贿赂

-   因应周遭事物演进的速度做事，你便有足够的力量达到目标了；这样整个环境是你的后盾，推动你前进。
    -   做事的方法和规律只是表象而已，随时都可以改； 可是原则和操守却千万不能变，因为那是大众的力量和意向，是你赖以成功的潜在支柱。 失去这个大靠山，我们便失去形势，那又怎能不失败？
    -   靠回佣搞关系 Man

我要对海耶克说声多谢

-   他从此便成为了我的良师益友

-   住在他们家里，有机会学会与人相处的规矩和礼仪，是个很宝贵的经验。 令我有信心起来， 可以更悠然自得地和别人相处，让人们有个更良好，更舒服的感觉。

-   读书是为了充实学问。 充实学问， 可以扩阔眼界，视野，加强分析能力，对生意的创造和判断决策都有帮助。

-   深厚的知识是做大事的基础。

纽约是我的幸运之都

-   心里盘算，怎样才可以造得比样板更好？

    -   把这批货做好并不足够，我们一定要做到一鸣惊人。 我们一定要 joe papa 印象深刻， 从此再不能不给我们生意。 我们不想再要求他给我们生意， 我要他需要我们，只有这样我才可以安枕无忧。
    -   可是我们志不在年前利润，而是这张订单带来的机会； 我们要的，是今后远远不绝的订单。 有了生意哪还怕赚不到钱吗？

    -   我的想法是， 直接到纽约跟 Joe Papa 面对面倾， 那么今后便可以在建立纽约的关系上， 沟通会更直接， 更清楚，更快捷。 再者， 直接到纽约跟 Joe Papa 接头， 便有机会接到他的其他生意，而不用受制于香港的分公司。

    -   努力更重要，因为只有努力才可以让人真正幸运起来。 努力使我们幸运，愈幸运我们便愈努力，因此而愈幸运。 幸运是靠努力赚回来的，要成功，除了努力之外，就是要继续更努力了。

大波莲与飞仔黎

-   我们直接处理生产流程，透过和工人的接触，交谈\\掌握他们工作上遇到的困难\\。 这样我们便有机会不断简化和修正生产系统，方法和程序。

    -   have periodic conversations with your employee
        -   good understanding of both the knowledge that the employee has,
            and also the understanding about the job that the employee has
            -   what is it that he or she is doing
            -   what are the ways in which it could be done differently
            -   do they see ways of improving what it is that they are doing

-   解决了每一天的困难，我也就学到新的东西，有新的体会，而更重要的是这让我发现自己新的能力。 那么我又怎能不每一天都兴奋莫名？

-   “虽然 Eddie 说你的品质不错，可是你是新厂，我为什么不给有关系，有默契的厂商落单，而要把生意转给你？”
    -   “我们的价钱较便宜而交货期又更快捷，况且你也不是对所有的厂都满意吧”

双手是大脑的先锋

-   我们于是收拾心情，决定不再计划，见步行步，以实际行动走出困境

-   我们都有个错觉，以为只有深思熟虑想出的办法才可以解决困难。 殊不知，在现实的世界里，我们只能从实践中掌握走出苦难的道路。

-   推动我们思维的，是实际行动； 带动脑袋的是我们自己的一双手。 工作是行动，实际行动令我们从工作中得到乐趣，使我们为工作而工作。 我们从实际行动中不断完善工作的方法，能力和概念。 在走向完善的过程中，会不断呈现激发我们投入工作的美妙境界，给我们带了乐趣。 这种美妙的乐趣令我们忘却以成功作为工作的目标，转而为工作而工作， 最后透过实践达至成功。

-   令人类进步最大的原动力，是从行动中发现自己的能力，并从中得到喜悦。

-   做生意的最终目标是满足最前线顾客的需要。 这样我便可以体味市场的变化，感受市场的脉搏。 由此我体会到厂商和客户相互依赖的关系。 自此我体会到厂商应该扮演一个什么的角色，而厂商又要建立一个什么的运作模式和生产架构才可以满足客户的要求。 我跨着市场巨浪滑到了一个我意想不到的新境界，我感受到的，是达至卓越的喜悦。

将骆驼往针孔里穿

-   年轻人理想多而顾及少； 不知天高地厚，冲劲有余，但却往往罔顾现实； 做生意，操守，诚信也较松懈； 只看到眼前利益，不顾长远效果。

-   到自己创业，身份变了，别人便会用另一种眼光看我们；以前的感情和信任没了，有的只是谨慎和顾忌。 如果对这眼光角度的改变懵然不知，不同时调校自己的观点和态度，只顾埋怨人情冷暖，那便是死路一条。

怎样当个好主管

-   用自己真的面孔和感受去面对下属，慢慢你就会赢到下属对你真正的尊敬。

-   不敢承担责任的主管，不是太过谨慎，缺乏进取，就是处处怕错，事事畏首畏尾， 因而令部门的工作没法开展

    -   同样，一个对别人抱着轻易否定态度的主管，不肯信任下属，事无大小都要插手去管，令员工没有发挥余地，变成了主管的办事工具

-   主要考虑他的性格和修养； 他是否自信，乐观，做人是否积极

    -   自信，乐观的主管办事不会怕出错。 他们敢承担，他们敢去闯，因而大大提高业务发展的机会，连带也提高员工的发展和晋升机会；
        当他们感觉到是会有发展的机会时，员工对工作就会更投入，办事效果也会更好 ，员工的士气也因此而提高

    -   积极待人的主管，会信任员工，给予员工更大的责任和权力，让他们有更多学习和发展的机会，使他们成长。
        用相互信任和沟通的办法，可以精简制度，减少员工面对的制肘，给他们更大的发挥空间。 当员工受到重用，他们对主管的信任也大大增加，
        由于彼此合作无间，部门运作的效率也就会大大地提高

    -   让心窝最深处的感觉告诉你是否真的要做这个事情； 真的要做，便去做好了。 到有一天你心疲力倦，做不来了，那么你总算知道自己的心没有搞错，只是力不从心罢了。

    -   做事要随心所欲，放下顾虑，什么也不想，放胆去做

    -   守得住是非好坏这一关，你便知对错，便不断有教训，不断有进步，那么迟早你也会事业有成的

        -   价值观

    -   要是能够抽离是非， 有了事实才下判断， 是非是明显不过的

        -   灵肉分离

    -   只有透过不同人的批判才能发现客观事实，找到事实真相

学习减少痛苦

-   没有痛苦的历练就没有快乐的体验

    -   没有真实生活的考验，人也就不会成熟，不会有坚强的性格

-   追求理想和解决问题是两回事

    -   理想是脱离现实设造出来的，解决问题则是从小处入手逐一克服困难的程序

    -   理想令我们抛离现实，可是做人做事最大的责任确是解决问题。
        人生是不完美的，是充满了意想不到的问题的。 不实实在在解决问题， 我们便会在牛角尖里死钻。

-   人生在世，我们都只能减少痛苦，而不能追求快乐
    -   我们知道什么东西会带来痛苦，尽量避开，从而给自己留下了快乐的空间。 只要习惯从负面去思考问题，正面的事情便应运而生了。

学习放下仇恨

-   仇恨纯粹是消耗

    -   爱有所得， 仇恨却只会带来痛苦

    -   仇恨是自我毁灭的循环，一场没有赢家的游戏

-   仇恨是个恶性循环的自我苦难游戏

    -   只有我们自己才感受到这个仇恨，被我们仇恨的人是感受不
    -   对别人的仇恨一点是仇恨自己的化身

-   仇恨的最大敌人是时间和人性宽恕的特性
    -   时间一过，起初的愤恨泄了，我们便再仇恨不起来
    -   时过境迁，感恩宽恕之心油然而生。一旦宽恕了，便再难提得起仇恨的执着

学习分辨是非黑白

-   是人的价值观令事情有了好坏之分。 事实是没有是非的。

    -   人们通常都不根究事实，只是关心事情的对错。 人都不能摆脱固有的立场和是非观来看世间事情
    -   只有透过不同人的批判才能发现客观的事实，找到事实的真相

-   对人而言，价值信念比事实更重要
    -   人是为信念真理，而不是事实而活的
-   只要不违法和违背社会公益，任何商业机构都会追求最高利润，都以赢为共同价值观

    -   在同一环境，机构共事的人却不该有不同的价值观

-   是非不分，往往是因为我们都先有了是非准则才去看事实

    -   要是能够抽离是非，有了事实才下判断，是非是明显不过的

    -   人难免受个人主观左右，看不到事实的整体。 故此只有透过不同的人的批判才能发现客观的事实，找到事实的真相

-   真理的基础是事实，真理的意义是对错

notes on <创业>

TODO

贿赂

-   因应周遭事物演进的速度做事，你便有足够的力量达到目标了；这样整个环境是你的后盾，推动你前进。
    -   做事的方法和规律只是表象而已，随时都可以改； 可是原则和操守却千万不能变，因为那是大众的力量和意向，是你赖以成功的潜在支柱。 失去这个大靠山，我们便失去形势，那又怎能不失败？
    -   靠回佣搞关系 Man

我要对海耶克说声多谢

-   他从此便成为了我的良师益友

-   住在他们家里，有机会学会与人相处的规矩和礼仪，是个很宝贵的经验。 令我有信心起来， 可以更悠然自得地和别人相处，让人们有个更良好，更舒服的感觉。

-   读书是为了充实学问。 充实学问， 可以扩阔眼界，视野，加强分析能力，对生意的创造和判断决策都有帮助。

-   深厚的知识是做大事的基础。

纽约是我的幸运之都

-   心里盘算，怎样才可以造得比样板更好？

    -   把这批货做好并不足够，我们一定要做到一鸣惊人。 我们一定要 joe papa 印象深刻， 从此再不能不给我们生意。 我们不想再要求他给我们生意， 我要他需要我们，只有这样我才可以安枕无忧。
    -   可是我们志不在年前利润，而是这张订单带来的机会； 我们要的，是今后远远不绝的订单。 有了生意哪还怕赚不到钱吗？

    -   我的想法是， 直接到纽约跟 Joe Papa 面对面倾， 那么今后便可以在建立纽约的关系上， 沟通会更直接， 更清楚，更快捷。 再者， 直接到纽约跟 Joe Papa 接头， 便有机会接到他的其他生意，而不用受制于香港的分公司。

    -   努力更重要，因为只有努力才可以让人真正幸运起来。 努力使我们幸运，愈幸运我们便愈努力，因此而愈幸运。 幸运是靠努力赚回来的，要成功，除了努力之外，就是要继续更努力了。

大波莲与飞仔黎

-   我们直接处理生产流程，透过和工人的接触，交谈\\掌握他们工作上遇到的困难\\。 这样我们便有机会不断简化和修正生产系统，方法和程序。

    -   have periodic conversations with your employee
        -   good understanding of both the knowledge that the employee has,
            and also the understanding about the job that the employee has
            -   what is it that he or she is doing
            -   what are the ways in which it could be done differently
            -   do they see ways of improving what it is that they are doing

-   解决了每一天的困难，我也就学到新的东西，有新的体会，而更重要的是这让我发现自己新的能力。 那么我又怎能不每一天都兴奋莫名？

-   “虽然 Eddie 说你的品质不错，可是你是新厂，我为什么不给有关系，有默契的厂商落单，而要把生意转给你？”
    -   “我们的价钱较便宜而交货期又更快捷，况且你也不是对所有的厂都满意吧”

双手是大脑的先锋

-   我们于是收拾心情，决定不再计划，见步行步，以实际行动走出困境

-   我们都有个错觉，以为只有深思熟虑想出的办法才可以解决困难。 殊不知，在现实的世界里，我们只能从实践中掌握走出苦难的道路。

-   推动我们思维的，是实际行动； 带动脑袋的是我们自己的一双手。 工作是行动，实际行动令我们从工作中得到乐趣，使我们为工作而工作。 我们从实际行动中不断完善工作的方法，能力和概念。 在走向完善的过程中，会不断呈现激发我们投入工作的美妙境界，给我们带了乐趣。 这种美妙的乐趣令我们忘却以成功作为工作的目标，转而为工作而工作， 最后透过实践达至成功。

-   令人类进步最大的原动力，是从行动中发现自己的能力，并从中得到喜悦。

-   做生意的最终目标是满足最前线顾客的需要。 这样我便可以体味市场的变化，感受市场的脉搏。 由此我体会到厂商和客户相互依赖的关系。 自此我体会到厂商应该扮演一个什么的角色，而厂商又要建立一个什么的运作模式和生产架构才可以满足客户的要求。 我跨着市场巨浪滑到了一个我意想不到的新境界，我感受到的，是达至卓越的喜悦。

将骆驼往针孔里穿

-   年轻人理想多而顾及少； 不知天高地厚，冲劲有余，但却往往罔顾现实； 做生意，操守，诚信也较松懈； 只看到眼前利益，不顾长远效果。

-   到自己创业，身份变了，别人便会用另一种眼光看我们；以前的感情和信任没了，有的只是谨慎和顾忌。 如果对这眼光角度的改变懵然不知，不同时调校自己的观点和态度，只顾埋怨人情冷暖，那便是死路一条。

-   做生意不按理出牌，行藏举止出位，令别人心里不舒服，因而得不到信任，那是很蚀底的。 要是别人对我们步步为营， 事事拿显微镜来看个究竟，那么我们做生意的交易费用偏会高昂得很。 谁肯和信不过的人培养关系？

-   诚信是做生意宝贵的资产。

-   我就是骑骆驼上路，希望在生意的旅途上，透过不断吸收教训，不断忏悔，将骆驼逐渐琢磨变成一条细小得穿得过针孔的骆驼毛，到其时天堂的路便会给我敞开了。

记住，那是一双好心人的手

-   跟我共事过的人都还对我的为人有信心
    -   有公信力又有资金的拍档来弥补我的不足； 性格随和

卖南乳花生也要做老板

-   我对什么事情都有主意，做事更不甘于给别人支配，很少理会别人怎样看我，会说些什么

诱惑

-   要摒除成见，更不能作任何假设，我要以一张白纸般的思想状态投入这新的挑战； 二， 要找出每一件事的问题所在，解决问题是我处理事情的门槛

-   投入这工作，便不能计较得失，否则眼界和胸襟会给成见局限，让先入为主的想法歪曲事物的真相。 要克服这些困难，我便要像唐憎取经那样，谦卑，虔诚地面对问题。

notes on <生意>

没有适合的意识便没有分寸

-   你有本事，靠得住，别人才珍惜跟你的关系

    -   以本事为基础，便自然会发展起 networking, 而不是有了人际关系才发展出生意来。人际关系是没有用的，生意关系是用本事胶结起来的网络，一旦本事消失这个网络也就瓦解了
    -   靠关系做生意是靠不住的

-   生活上的关系靠感情来维系， 生意上的关系则要靠本事来巩固

    -   不要花时间气力搞人际关系， 集中精神搞好本业，关系便自然会从四面八方贴上来。 否则，只顾一味搞关系，最终你反而朋友，生意两失。

-   做生意从来都是 尝试与失败的学习的过程

    -   我建议你到市场寻找你最喜欢，最配合自己品味感觉的店铺，要是这些店铺生意成功，那便可以作为你模仿的对象，透过模仿建立自己的个性了

    -   学习是由模仿开始的； 要创新便先要模仿成功的案例

-   经营时装店一定要自己独资，不要跟别人合伙

    -   独立经营，你便可以对工作和人事有自己的主张，判断。 这样做你难免会碰钉，可是这也可以教你从错误和失败中取得教训，而不能诿过于别人。 逃避责任不是学习的办法。 独资经营你便要承担一切后果，培养做事的勇气，能力和意志力，归根到底那才是生意成功的要素

    -   你要找助手帮你打理店铺，但一位便足够了。 助手的人选最好是年纪大点，较为成熟的，这样的助手不仅可以在工作上给你助力，还可以在精神上支持你。 创业必然面对许多困难，难免情绪低落，故此精神上的支持不可少。 不过千万别找自己的朋友做助手，否则便不难因为生意而赔上友情了。

-   创业最紧要懂得节俭，控制好成本，否则生意再好也会失败

    -   做小生意你先便要有小生意的金钱价值观，带入小生意人的心态

    -   做生意靠的不仅是能力，心态也很重要。 不是像小生意人那样生活，便不会有他们的心态，无从体味做小生意的苦与乐，发展不出自小便开始做生意的人的意识和感受

生意： 以果为因

-   按结果的需要来决定每个运作步骤的程序

    -   我是有了卖五十个款式这个“终极”目标 - 结果， 才决定走向这个目标的每一个步骤

-   现有了市场需求的概念，决定了目标，才采取行动
    -   作这个分拆，捆绑决定时，我靠的是市场的触觉， 和由这个触觉引发我对市场销售情景的想象力；
        有了想像到的销售结果，我再回头考虑 a,b 两册分拆和捆绑的不同做法。最后经过数个星期的尝试，修正和探索才成功掌握分拆和捆绑的做法

做生意的心得

-   我是希望她可以透过尝试，摸索出做生意的心得

    -   反正是学习吧， 店铺大小学习曲线都没有区别； 不同的是，起步之初是很难不蚀本的； 店愈大便蚀得愈多；店小租金也少可以少蚀些

    -   我怕她只顾听我的话，而不敢自己拿主意。 那么她便没有机会犯错，因而也就无从吸取经验了。 一定要自己闯祸才体味得出心得的

-   心得是从现实生活的喜乐成败中提炼出来的直觉

    -   书本和别人教导的知识都附带客观的“情景” - 譬如要在某些情况下才可以用上某种知识； 在现实世界做生意，主观和客观情景却是缠在一起， 完全分不开来

    -   这个时候最重要的是，是有人帮衬；有生意可做，她便有机会累积经验，进而提炼出做生意的心得；有了心得，生意便有前途了

顾客的需要

-   创造便是找出顾客面对的困难，不断尝试解决这些困难  
     -消费者是市场的奴隶而不是主人的社会主义计划经济

无 Q 用的

-   从别人的经验中得到启发，对生意激情地投入

    -   得到启发，最后将之变成自己的概念。 有了概念，再从尝试与失败中摸索，便会找到答案了

    -   我们要靠想象力和亲身的尝试摸索给这些概念赋予新的生命，令它复活

创业不是追求理想

参与

body:
self-confidence  - an outcome of doing well  
  understand, value, and apply the Core Assets -> happier, and more resilient  

find & nurture your strengths 
   personality features 
    + friendliness  
    + open-minded  
    + reliable  

   character traits  
    + kindness
    + grit  
    + patience  
    + guileless / honest  
    + 倔强  

   alents and gifts  
    + enjoy the beauty 
    + logical thinking    
    + 社会学  
    + TOCHECK  
        - "哪一類事情自己輕而易舉"

   TO improve  
    + poss power and money  
        - being better than others 

    + 让自己在乎的人 感觉到 自己很在意她 
        - 表达 

    + 商业思维  
        - 利益为先  

    + 具体的经验  
        - how， not why  

    + know how to filter out friends  

compensate for the weaknesses  
   language  


Empathy  - think "we", not "me"  
 help us care about each other and help bring out the humanity in the best possible way  

 build relationship satisfaction  

affective empathy - feel with another  
 recognize and feel others' emotions   

 read nonverbal cues in facial expressions, gestures, posture, and vocie tone  
    - happy, sad, stressed, scared, frustrated, and angry  
    - ask 
        + "How did that make you feel?"  
        + "are you anxious, worried, sad?" 
    - share feelings in a safe way  
        + "I'm frustrated with this book." 
        + "I'm irritable ..."  

    - create family connections
        + "what was the best/hardest/most fun part of your day and why"  

 listening fully  
    - look eye-to-eye or on the wall behind the speaker's head  
    - try to learn one common thing about the person or sth you have in common    
        + "we both like ... "  
        + "we had the same ..."  

    - label the feeling  
        + "you sound stressed" 
        + "you seem angry"  
        + " you look happy"  
        + "can I help", "I'm glad you told me"  

cognitive empathy   - perspective taking  
 step into her shoes, understand his view and take his perspective  

 understand others' feelings, thoughts, and desires  
    - they can grasp others' needs 

behavioral empathy  - act with compassion  
 do something to help  

 how to care  
    - console - "I'm sorry", "You didn't deserve that"    
    - assist  -  "Do u need help?"   
    - reassure - "I'm here for you"  
    - empathize - "I know how you feel"


self-control - control their focus, impulses, and thoughts  

Focus on what matters      
 Notice your thoughts  
    - "What your body feels like"  
    - "What your ears hear"  
    - "what is happening right now"  

 recoginze  
    - "How am I feeling" -> "what's causing it"   
    - take a slow, deep breath -> calm down  

 positive self-talk  
    - "I think I can"  
    - "I can get through this"  
    - "I don't like it, but I can handle it"  
    - "Stay calm. Carry on"  

 Stop, Think, Act Right 

self-management  

healthy decision-making  

Integrity - be good people and do the right thing  
 strong moral compasses  
    - know what's right, care about what's right, and do what's right  
    - this sets boundaries, resist temptations, and guide on how to act the right way  
    - it gives peace of mind when you do the right thing   
    - thus you are true to yourself and honest with others  

 learn by example 
    - warmth, reasonable demands, and high responsiveness    
    - "You know our rules - I know you can do better."     


Curiosity

title: nothings-free
excerpt: [AI Synthesis]: Every worthwhile outcome has a price—not always on a label. Treat volatility and doubt as fees for admission, not fines for mistakes. Everything has a price Everything has a price, bu…
excerpt_search: [AI Synthesis]: Every worthwhile outcome has a price—not always on a label. Treat volatility and doubt as fees for admission, not fines for mistakes. Everything has a price Everything has a price, bu…
body:
[AI Synthesis]: Every worthwhile outcome has a price—not always on a label. Treat volatility and doubt as fees for admission, not fines for mistakes.

Everything has a price
 Everything has a price, but not all prices appear on labels.
 The key is figuring out what the price is and being willing to pay it.

The hidden price of investing success
 The price of investing success is not immediately obvious.
 It is not a visible price tag—when the bill arrives it feels like a fine for doing something wrong, not a fee for something good.
 Volatility is real and common.

Volatility as fee, not fine
 Thinking of market volatility as a fee rather than a fine helps you stick around long enough for gains to work.
 The volatility/uncertainty fee—the price of returns—is the cost of admission to returns greater than low-fee options like cash and bonds.
 If you treat the admission fee as a fine, you will never enjoy the magic.
 Find the price, then pay it.

Define the cost of success
 Define the cost of success and be ready to pay it—nothing worthwhile is free.
 Most financial costs lack visible price tags.
 Uncertainty, doubt, and regret are common costs in finance; they are often worth paying if you view them as fees (price for something nice) rather than fines (penalty to avoid).

Actions
 Before investing, write down the volatility and regret you are willing to pay as fees—not surprises to panic over.
 When markets move against you, ask whether you are paying a known fee or breaking a rule.

Sources

| Source | Location | Role |
|--------|----------|------|
| books/The psychology of money.md | ch15 Nothing’s Free; ch19 | primary |
| notes/2026-08-05-the-psychology-of-money.md | ch15; ch19 | highlights |

Related Topics
- reasonable-not-rational
- staying-wealthy
- seduction-of-pessimism
- tails-you-win

body:
> 關於教育 - 摘錄自《魔鬼老大，天使老二》
Note from Bruce Lee (from experience and observations） The best way of learning is not through the computation of information. When we discover, we are uncovering our own ability, our own eyes, in order to find our potential, to see what is going on, to discover how we can enlarge our lives, to find the means at our disposal that will let us cope with a difficult situation. The ability to really see is something like "I am experiencing this; now I feel this; now I don't want to work anymore; now I am bored." and sequently the world is opening up. ch1 来自于 《魔鬼老大，天使老二》 喜歡创造的感觉 - 在自己手里花长时间创作出完美的作品，在职业上从技术转向产品。 关注他们的智力和技能，也会关注他们的情感和品德。都需要成长为快乐的，独立的，有用的人。 ch2 智力开发和习惯 专注的能力 - 专注做一件事情 时间管理 - 哪些时间花得有价值，哪些没什么收益，又自己想办法改进 阅读 - 使阅读成为一个享受的过程。这种享受，才是阅读带来的最大收益 一本“正在读的书” - 读书不是完成任务，也没有任何目的，它只是一件“一直在做的事”， 有空就做。 一定不会把许多时间花在追求考试的名次上，花时间在广泛阅读，探索自己感兴趣的领域，培养表达能力等方面。 希望能培养一个享受学习本身的人。 学习中文，是希望能很好地阅读，流利地交流，擅长写作，考试不重要。 学文要真正融会贯通。学习文科的目标很实用：能写好文章，能清晰地交流，能有自己的创意和思考。 学理需要懂得逻辑缘由。 学理的目标是理解：他需要懂得每一个步骤背后的概念和逻辑。 ch3 创造力 大量阅读高质量小说的孩子往往更有创意，更容易保持对世界的新鲜感。 教孩子严谨地，踏实地，一步步地做一件完美的事。设计和产品是一个锻炼完整的思考和执行的过程，是学会问问题和解决问题的过程。最终完成的产品必须是完整的。 所有产品，从如何满足用户需求，到如何赏心悦目，都是特别重要的。在这个过程中，我发现许多人专业技能很强，但缺乏全面统筹的能力，他们按自己的想法做事而不站在他人的立场，偏重难点而忽略体验，他们可以完成任务，但无法进行领导和协调。 东西方教育最大的区别更在于独立性和批判性思维。 独立的人格，批判而公正的思考能力，最终决定了一个人的内在格局与境界。 通识（liberal study）教育是培养学生批判性和独立思考及终身学习的能力，一旦有这些能力，他们自然会学到所需要的专业技能，做出正确的判断。所谓通识或自由教育，其本质是对心灵自由的滋养，其核心就是自由的精神，远大的志向，公民的责任。 未来的学习是永不止境的，对自身的批判性想法很重要。知道自己懂什么，不懂什么，以及与别人有什么不同。自我提升能力特别关键，只有看到周围的需求，看到自己的不足，才有可能不断自我提升。 只有少数人掌握驱动大事的复杂技能，大批人从事重复的简单劳动。 复杂问题分解-> 先骨架，再细化； 先能工作的“产品”，再丰富和细化。 博士训练可以得到一种解决复杂问题的能力。比如分析问题->预测问题的复杂程度和工作量，分解问题，看出关键点; 不怕未知，理解路途中遇到的曲折。 “1 万小时规则”，是指花在改进和更卓越的练习上的时间，是指刻意的，自我批判的，反复的练习。 只有发自内心的乐于求知的热情，才能有长久坚持的耐心。 不会有人手把手教你怎么去做。这个时候，拥抱未知，相信自己能够学会，并且一步步踏实学习的人，就是新领域的驾驶者。 东方教育的孩子有硬技能却不能活学活用，害怕不确定性，不愿冒险。如能加上西方教育的创造性，实用性，敢于探索的精神，就能成最优秀的人。 ch4 更幸福 应试教育最大的问题是 孩子丧失了“享受做事”的能力。 认识了不少美国的程序员，他们都很热爱编程。编程是用一个完美的逻辑解决问题，是一个很享受的过程。我们缺失了这种忘我的快乐。 真正享受过程的人。 走向“精通”(mastery)，是更内在的。大师，不靠外人评价其功夫高低。掌握一件事，可以不断地追求，不断做得更好，也可以一次一次反复做。整个到达精通的过程就是享受的过程 (flow)。 一个人幸福与否往往在于他的内心，在于他看问题的角度。西方文化精华的一部分在于心平气和的态度。 如果真遇到不幸的事，不是去怪罪命运，而是接受已经发生的，甚至把挫折看作计划。 希望孩子能以同样的心情接纳和自己不一样的他人，以及不完美的人生。 体育训练是一个挑战自己，实现长远目标的方式。他越来越喜欢足球，开始享受精通这种运动带来的快乐。 旅游是一家人一起享受和玩乐的机会。 自信的定义是无论顺境逆境，一个人即不把自己看得过于强大，也不把自己看得过于弱小，他对自己有合适，客观的看法。 鼓励孩子积极面对自己，积极面对他人。 要孩子自信，很大程度上要他能够接受其他优秀的朋友。 我们要鼓励孩子用正确的态度欣赏他人的优点。 有这些出色的朋友真是好事，让我们有机会欣赏一流的音乐。 赞扬的目的不是贬斥自己的孩子，而是要他学会由衷地欣赏他人，轻松地和其他优秀的孩子相处。 需要外在肯定自己才会高兴的孩子未必是最自信的。自信，不是一个外在的表现，而更多是内在对自己的认同和对其他人的认同。 先学会“做好一件事”， 再学会“知道你的角色和团队协作”，以及学会“如何与不同的人沟通”，以后再考虑领导力的事。真正的领袖，他们的共性是谦逊，自我约束，勤奋，讲究效率，他们有对人的理解，有对一件事反复操作的耐心。 做实事积累到一定程度，加上不断自我学习，反思和进步，领导力自然会应运而生。 领导力包含许多方面：对不同背景的人的理解和激励，见识，阅历，耐心，以及在困难情况下做决定的能力。 ch5 - 身教比言传更重要 钱是工具，它是为我们服务的。 比礼仪更重要的，是对人的尊重。内心对尊重真正的认同，比形式更重要。 整洁，朴素，有品味，是从一点一滴，耳濡目染的日常生活中学到的。 聆听 - 不要立刻纠正他们的错误，不要批判他们的朋友或喜欢，要让他们将你视为盟友。 尊重所有人，尤其是所有以劳动为生的人。我们与所有人的交往都以平等，尊重开始。 然后，这个人的行为会决定我们是否继续对他保持尊重。 不要把人按照他们的背景固化。 我们不要成为狭隘的人，以“我们”和“他们”来做判断。即不崇拜，也不鄙视与自己不一样的人。我们任务只有多样化的团队才能做出最好的产品，大家在一起也最有乐趣。 价值观属于我们内心认同，不愿退让的东西。比如善待他人，善待自己，没有偏见，简单生活，做有用的人。 家，社区是最温暖的地方，是属于我们自己的东西：亲密的朋友，家人，熟悉的歌曲，任何时候伸出双手就可以触及的信任和亲情。 ch6 - 放大快乐

The ability to really see is something like "I am experiencing this; now I feel this; now I don't want to work anymore; now I am bored." and sequently the world is opening up. ch1 來自於 《魔鬼老大，天使老二》 喜歡創造的感覺 - 在自己手裏花長時間創作出完美的作品，在職業上從技術轉向產品。 關注他們的智力和技能，也會關注他們的情感和品德。都需要成長爲快樂的，獨立的，有用的人。 ch2 智力開發和習慣 專注的能力 - 專注做一件事情 時間管理 - 哪些時間花得有價值，哪些沒什麼收益，又自己想辦法改進 閱讀 - 使閱讀成爲一個享受的過程。這種享受，纔是閱讀帶來的最大收益 一本“正在讀的書” - 讀書不是完成任務，也沒有任何目的，它只是一件“一直在做的事”， 有空就做。 一定不會把許多時間花在追求考試的名次上，花時間在廣泛閱讀，探索自己感興趣的領域，培養表達能力等方面。 希望能培養一個享受學習本身的人。 學習中文，是希望能很好地閱讀，流利地交流，擅長寫作，考試不重要。 學文要真正融會貫通。學習文科的目標很實用：能寫好文章，能清晰地交流，能有自己的創意和思考。 學理需要懂得邏輯緣由。 學理的目標是理解：他需要懂得每一個步驟背後的概念和邏輯。 ch3 創造力 大量閱讀高質量小說的孩子往往更有創意，更容易保持對世界的新鮮感。 教孩子嚴謹地，踏實地，一步步地做一件完美的事。設計和產品是一個鍛鍊完整的思考和執行的過程，是學會問問題和解決問題的過程。最終完成的產品必須是完整的。 所有產品，從如何滿足用戶需求，到如何賞心悅目，都是特別重要的。在這個過程中，我發現許多人專業技能很強，但缺乏全面統籌的能力，他們按自己的想法做事而不站在他人的立場，偏重難點而忽略體驗，他們可以完成任務，但無法進行領導和協調。 東西方教育最大的區別更在於獨立性和批判性思維。 獨立的人格，批判而公正的思考能力，最終決定了一個人的內在格局與境界。 通識（liberal study）教育是培養學生批判性和獨立思考及終身學習的能力，一旦有這些能力，他們自然會學到所需要的專業技能，做出正確的判斷。所謂通識或自由教育，其本質是對心靈自由的滋養，其核心就是自由的精神，遠大的志向，公民的責任。 未來的學習是永不止境的，對自身的批判性想法很重要。知道自己懂什麼，不懂什麼，以及與別人有什麼不同。自我提升能力特別關鍵，只有看到周圍的需求，看到自己的不足，纔有可能不斷自我提升。 只有少數人掌握驅動大事的複雜技能，大批人從事重複的簡單勞動。 複雜問題分解-> 先骨架，再細化； 先能工作的“產品”，再豐富和細化。 博士訓練可以得到一種解決複雜問題的能力。比如分析問題->預測問題的複雜程度和工作量，分解問題，看出關鍵點; 不怕未知，理解路途中遇到的曲折。 “1 萬小時規則”，是指花在改進和更卓越的練習上的時間，是指刻意的，自我批判的，反覆的練習。 只有發自內心的樂於求知的熱情，纔能有長久堅持的耐心。 不會有人手把手教你怎麼去做。這個時候，擁抱未知，相信自己能夠學會，並且一步步踏實學習的人，就是新領域的駕駛者。 東方教育的孩子有硬技能卻不能活學活用，害怕不確定性，不願冒險。如能加上西方教育的創造性，實用性，敢於探索的精神，就能成最優秀的人。 ch4 更幸福 應試教育最大的問題是 孩子喪失了“享受做事”的能力。 認識了不少美國的程序員，他們都很熱愛編程。編程是用一個完美的邏輯解決問題，是一個很享受的過程。我們缺失了這種忘我的快樂。 真正享受過程的人。 走向“精通”(mastery)，是更內在的。大師，不靠外人評價其功夫高低。掌握一件事，可以不斷地追求，不斷做得更好，也可以一次一次反覆做。整個到達精通的過程就是享受的過程 (flow)。 一個人幸福與否往往在於他的內心，在於他看問題的角度。西方文化精華的一部分在於心平氣和的態度。 如果真遇到不幸的事，不是去怪罪命運，而是接受已經發生的，甚至把挫折看作計劃。 希望孩子能以同樣的心情接納和自己不一樣的他人，以及不完美的人生。 體育訓練是一個挑戰自己，實現長遠目標的方式。他越來越喜歡足球，開始享受精通這種運動帶來的快樂。 旅遊是一家人一起享受和玩樂的機會。 自信的定義是無論順境逆境，一個人即不把自己看得過於強大，也不把自己看得過於弱小，他對自己有合適，客觀的看法。 鼓勵孩子積極面對自己，積極面對他人。 要孩子自信，很大程度上要他能夠接受其他優秀的朋友。 我們要鼓勵孩子用正確的態度欣賞他人的優點。 有這些出色的朋友真是好事，讓我們有機會欣賞一流的音樂。 讚揚的目的不是貶斥自己的孩子，而是要他學會由衷地欣賞他人，輕鬆地和其他優秀的孩子相處。 需要外在肯定自己纔會高興的孩子未必是最自信的。自信，不是一個外在的表現，而更多是內在對自己的認同和對其他人的認同。 先學會“做好一件事”， 再學會“知道你的角色和團隊協作”，以及學會“如何與不同的人溝通”，以後再考慮領導力的事。真正的領袖，他們的共性是謙遜，自我約束，勤奮，講究效率，他們有對人的理解，有對一件事反覆操作的耐心。 做實事積累到一定程度，加上不斷自我學習，反思和進步，領導力自然會應運而生。 領導力包含許多方面：對不同背景的人的理解和激勵，見識，閱歷，耐心，以及在困難情況下做決定的能力。 ch5 - 身教比言傳更重要 錢是工具，它是爲我們服務的。 比禮儀更重要的，是對人的尊重。內心對尊重真正的認同，比形式更重要。 整潔，樸素，有品味，是從一點一滴，耳濡目染的日常生活中學到的。 聆聽 - 不要立刻糾正他們的錯誤，不要批判他們的朋友或喜歡，要讓他們將你視爲盟友。 尊重所有人，尤其是所有以勞動爲生的人。我們與所有人的交往都以平等，尊重開始。 然後，這個人的行爲會決定我們是否繼續對他保持尊重。 不要把人按照他們的背景固化。 我們不要成爲狹隘的人，以“我們”和“他們”來做判斷。即不崇拜，也不鄙視與自己不一樣的人。我們任務只有多樣化的團隊才能做出最好的產品，大家在一起也最有樂趣。 價值觀屬於我們內心認同，不願退讓的東西。比如善待他人，善待自己，沒有偏見，簡單生活，做有用的人。 家，社區是最溫暖的地方，是屬於我們自己的東西：親密的朋友，家人，熟悉的歌曲，任何時候伸出雙手就可以觸及的信任和親情。 ch6 - 放大快樂 > 关于教育 - 摘录自《魔鬼老大，天使老二》
Note from Bruce Lee (from experience and observations） The best way of learning is not through the computation of information. When we discover, we are uncovering our own ability, our own eyes, in order to find our potential, to see what is going on, to discover how we can enlarge our lives, to find the means at our disposal that will let us cope with a difficult situation. The ability to really see is something like "I am experiencing this; now I feel this; now I don't want to work anymore; now I am bored." and sequently the world is opening up. ch1 来自于 《魔鬼老大，天使老二》 喜欢创造的感觉 - 在自己手里花长时间创作出完美的作品，在职业上从技术转向产品。 关注他们的智力和技能，也会关注他们的情感和品德。都需要成长为快乐的，独立的，有用的人。 ch2 智力开发和习惯 专注的能力 - 专注做一件事情 时间管理 - 哪些时间花得有价值，哪些没什么收益，又自己想办法改进 阅读 - 使阅读成为一个享受的过程。这种享受，才是阅读带来的最大收益 一本“正在读的书” - 读书不是完成任务，也没有任何目的，它只是一件“一直在做的事”， 有空就做。 一定不会把许多时间花在追求考试的名次上，花时间在广泛阅读，探索自己感兴趣的领域，培养表达能力等方面。 希望能培养一个享受学习本身的人。 学习中文，是希望能很好地阅读，流利地交流，擅长写作，考试不重要。 学文要真正融会贯通。学习文科的目标很实用：能写好文章，能清晰地交流，能有自己的创意和思考。 学理需要懂得逻辑缘由。 学理的目标是理解：他需要懂得每一个步骤背后的概念和逻辑。 ch3 创造力 大量阅读高质量小说的孩子往往更有创意，更容易保持对世界的新鲜感。 教孩子严谨地，踏实地，一步步地做一件完美的事。设计和产品是一个锻炼完整的思考和执行的过程，是学会问问题和解决问题的过程。最终完成的产品必须是完整的。 所有产品，从如何满足用户需求，到如何赏心悦目，都是特别重要的。在这个过程中，我发现许多人专业技能很强，但缺乏全面统筹的能力，他们按自己的想法做事而不站在他人的立场，偏重难点而忽略体验，他们可以完成任务，但无法进行领导和协调。 东西方教育最大的区别更在于独立性和批判性思维。 独立的人格，批判而公正的思考能力，最终决定了一个人的内在格局与境界。 通识（liberal study）教育是培养学生批判性和独立思考及终身学习的能力，一旦有这些能力，他们自然会学到所需要的专业技能，做出正确的判断。所谓通识或自由教育，其本质是对心灵自由的滋养，其核心就是自由的精神，远大的志向，公民的责任。 未来的学习是永不止境的，对自身的批判性想法很重要。知道自己懂什么，不懂什么，以及与别人有什么不同。自我提升能力特别关键，只有看到周围的需求，看到自己的不足，才有可能不断自我提升。 只有少数人掌握驱动大事的复杂技能，大批人从事重复的简单劳动。 复杂问题分解-> 先骨架，再细化； 先能工作的“产品”，再丰富和细化。 博士训练可以得到一种解决复杂问题的能力。比如分析问题->预测问题的复杂程度和工作量，分解问题，看出关键点; 不怕未知，理解路途中遇到的曲折。 “1 万小时规则”，是指花在改进和更卓越的练习上的时间，是指刻意的，自我批判的，反复的练习。 只有发自内心的乐于求知的热情，才能有长久坚持的耐心。 不会有人手把手教你怎么去做。这个时候，拥抱未知，相信自己能够学会，并且一步步踏实学习的人，就是新领域的驾驶者。 东方教育的孩子有硬技能却不能活学活用，害怕不确定性，不愿冒险。如能加上西方教育的创造性，实用性，敢于探索的精神，就能成最优秀的人。 ch4 更幸福 应试教育最大的问题是 孩子丧失了“享受做事”的能力。 认识了不少美国的程序员，他们都很热爱编程。编程是用一个完美的逻辑解决问题，是一个很享受的过程。我们缺失了这种忘我的快乐。 真正享受过程的人。 走向“精通”(mastery)，是更内在的。大师，不靠外人评价其功夫高低。掌握一件事，可以不断地追求，不断做得更好，也可以一次一次反复做。整个到达精通的过程就是享受的过程 (flow)。 一个人幸福与否往往在于他的内心，在于他看问题的角度。西方文化精华的一部分在于心平气和的态度。 如果真遇到不幸的事，不是去怪罪命运，而是接受已经发生的，甚至把挫折看作计划。 希望孩子能以同样的心情接纳和自己不一样的他人，以及不完美的人生。 体育训练是一个挑战自己，实现长远目标的方式。他越来越喜欢足球，开始享受精通这种运动带来的快乐。 旅游是一家人一起享受和玩乐的机会。 自信的定义是无论顺境逆境，一个人即不把自己看得过于强大，也不把自己看得过于弱小，他对自己有合适，客观的看法。 鼓励孩子积极面对自己，积极面对他人。 要孩子自信，很大程度上要他能够接受其他优秀的朋友。 我们要鼓励孩子用正确的态度欣赏他人的优点。 有这些出色的朋友真是好事，让我们有机会欣赏一流的音乐。 赞扬的目的不是贬斥自己的孩子，而是要他学会由衷地欣赏他人，轻松地和其他优秀的孩子相处。 需要外在肯定自己才会高兴的孩子未必是最自信的。自信，不是一个外在的表现，而更多是内在对自己的认同和对其他人的认同。 先学会“做好一件事”， 再学会“知道你的角色和团队协作”，以及学会“如何与不同的人沟通”，以后再考虑领导力的事。真正的领袖，他们的共性是谦逊，自我约束，勤奋，讲究效率，他们有对人的理解，有对一件事反复操作的耐心。 做实事积累到一定程度，加上不断自我学习，反思和进步，领导力自然会应运而生。 领导力包含许多方面：对不同背景的人的理解和激励，见识，阅历，耐心，以及在困难情况下做决定的能力。 ch5 - 身教比言传更重要 钱是工具，它是为我们服务的。 比礼仪更重要的，是对人的尊重。内心对尊重真正的认同，比形式更重要。 整洁，朴素，有品味，是从一点一滴，耳濡目染的日常生活中学到的。 聆听 - 不要立刻纠正他们的错误，不要批判他们的朋友或喜欢，要让他们将你视为盟友。 尊重所有人，尤其是所有以劳动为生的人。我们与所有人的交往都以平等，尊重开始。 然后，这个人的行为会决定我们是否继续对他保持尊重。 不要把人按照他们的背景固化。 我们不要成为狭隘的人，以“我们”和“他们”来做判断。即不崇拜，也不鄙视与自己不一样的人。我们任务只有多样化的团队才能做出最好的产品，大家在一起也最有乐趣。 价值观属于我们内心认同，不愿退让的东西。比如善待他人，善待自己，没有偏见，简单生活，做有用的人。 家，社区是最温暖的地方，是属于我们自己的东西：亲密的朋友，家人，熟悉的歌曲，任何时候伸出双手就可以触及的信任和亲情。 ch6 - 放大快乐

body:
skills  
 slow down your speaking speed  
    - select your words carefully  
    
 give yourself time to think  
    - relax  
    - "that's a good question. Let me think for a moment"  
    - "I haven't thought about it beofre ... "  
    - "Well ... I suppose ... "  
    - "well, during the day ..."  
    - "In the meantime why don't we ..."  
    - "It's been a long time since ... "  
    - "Sorry to trouble you ... but ... "  
    - "would you mind if ..."   
    - "oh! come on" ...  
    - "I'm just kidding ... "  

 learn complete sentences  
 learn to listen  
    - listen what others are saying  

 practice asking questions  
    - "what are your views on that?"  
    - "How about you, what do you think?"  

 produce english by writing  


how to negotiate 
 Making your position clear  
    - "I suggest starting small and scaling up later"  
    - "We're thinking of starting with around 500 units per SKU"  
    - "We'd prefer to keep things flexible to begin with"  

 asking questions  - more information 
    - "what kind of volumes are we looking at?"  
    - "What's the situation regarding production and delivery?"  
    - "what do u have in mind exactly?"   
    - "And that would be per-month, or ...?"  

 Setting conditoins  - suggest sometimes  or possibilities  
    - "if ..., would you be able to go ..." 
    - "If we commit to a longer contract, can you offer us a better price?"
    - "If we agreed to ..., would that make the deal work for you?"

    - "Assuming that you need ..., we could offer ... "  
    - "Supposing you could commit to ..., we could go ..."  
    - "As long as there were some limitations on the delivery timing, I  think that would be acceptable."
        + "As long as" has opposite meaning, this means the limitations are necessary   

 Expressing disagreement  - could direct  
    - "We won't be able to offer you the lower price. "  
    - "We can't offer our best prices without a regular commitment on your part"  
    - "We're not willing to absorb those costs"  
   
    - "I'll come right out and say that's not going to work for us"  
    - "There's no way around this"  
    - "I'm sorry but I have to draw a line here"  

    - "Shall we take 5 minitues break"  

 Introducing new ideas  
    - "I have a proposal which I hope can make this work for everyone.  "  
    - "Here's my solution: "  
    - "I will make another offer "  

 Asking for new ideas  
    - "What's your idea?"  
    - "What would you suggest?"  

 Reacting to new ideas 
    - "That's a good offer"  
    - "I think this should be feasible."  

 Summarize what you agreed and outline next steps  
    - "Let's go through the main points: "  
    - "Regarding delivery,"  
   
    - "We still need to settle the exact details of " 
    - "There's also the mattle of ... "  
   
    - "We'll put this in writing"  
    - "We'll send you a provisional agreement"  
    - "We can work on getting a contract drawn up"

"Can I have .., please?"  

decline - "That is a good idea. I would like to join in but I have another appointment today."  

sorry - "I want to apologise."  "I owe you an apology"  "my mistake"  "I want to apologise for my behavior / to someone"  "I sincerely apologise" .. "I take full responsibly ..."

title: Part one: Happiness Revisited
excerpt: > <small>This is a summary from the book 《Flow》, which mainly presents concrete examples and general principles to transform boring and meaningless lives into ones full of enjoyment. </small> Content…
excerpt_search: > <small>This is a summary from the book 《Flow》, which mainly presents concrete examples and general principles to transform boring and meaningless lives into ones full of enjoyment. </small> Content…
body:
> <small>This is a summary from the book 《Flow》, which mainly presents concrete examples and general principles to transform boring and meaningless lives into ones full of enjoyment. </small>

Content

We often ask ourselves the similar questions like: <font color="#800080">How could we have more enjoyable life? When do we feel most happy? </font>

Author Mihaly Csikzentmihalyi lists the examples to show that it does not depend on outside events, but,rather, on how we interpret them. Also we cannot reach happiness by consciously searching for it.Because it is by being fully involved with every detail of our lives, whether good or bad, that we find happiness, not by trying to look for it directly. But there is a circuitous path that begins with achieving control over the contents of our consciousness.

Our perceptions about our lives are the outcome of many forces that shape experience,each having an impact on whether we feel good or bad. Most of these forces are outside our control, such as our looks, our temperament, or our constitution and so on. Yet we can do feel in control of our actions, masters of our own fate. On the rare occasions that it happens, we feel a sense of exhilaration, a deep sense of enjoyment that is long cherished, which is optimal experienceMihaly called. Optimal experience is something that we make happen in the moments, which usually occur when a person’s body or mind is stretched to its limits in a voluntary effort to accomplish something difficult and worthwhile. Of course, such experiences are not necessarily pleasant at the time they occur. For example, the swimmer’s muscles might have ached during his most memorable race yet this could have been the best moments of his life. The theory of Optimal experience is based on the concept of flow ( joy, creativity, the process of total involvement with life) -the state in which people are so involved in an activity that nothing else seems to matter; the experience itself is so enjoyable that people will do it even at great cost, for the sheer sake of doing it.

Happiness is so hard to achieve is that the universe was not designed with the comfort of human beings in mind, in other words, the universe is simply indifferent. It is prudent not to expect that efforts to change external conditions will immediately improve the quality of our lives. Another reason is that we always hope rising expectations. Over the course of human evolution, each group of people developed myths and beliefs to transform the random, crushing forces of the universe into manageable, or at least understandable patterns. These religions provided satisfying goals for people to spend their lives pursuing. But today it is more difficult to accept the truths the religions have presented as definitive, because the forms no longer compels belief in an era of scientific rationality. A vital new religion may one day arise again but it is not now.

Today, to overcome the anxieties and depressions of contemporary life with material splendor and astonishing variety of ills, apart from the goals others use to bribe us with, individuals should improve the content of experience and develop a set of our own. The most important step in emancipating oneself from social controls is the ability to find rewards in the events of each moment. If a person learns to enjoy and find meaning in the ongoing stream of experience, in the process of living itself, power returns to the person when rewards are no longer relegated to outside forces. It is no longer necessary to struggle for goals that always seem to recede into the future, to end each boring day with the hope that tomorrow, perhaps, something good will happen. But it is not by abandoning ourselves to instinctual desires that we become free of social controls. We must also become independent from the dictates of the body(We cannot deny the facts of nature like eating or sexual intercourse, but we should certainly try to improve on them), and learn to take charge of what happens in the mind. Pain and pleasure occur in consciousness and exist only there. To the extent that a frown from the boss spoils the day, we are not free to determine the content of experience. Since what we experience is reality, as far as we are concerned, we can transform reality to the extent that we influence what happens in consciousness and thus free ourselves from the threats and blandishments of the outside world.

All in all, the way is through control over consciousness, which in turn leads to control over the quality of experience. Then there is a question, how consciousness works and what it actually means to have experiences? The answer will be in Part Two .

title: Part two: The Anatomy of Consciousness

excerpt_search: > <small>The summary tries to answer the question: how consciousness works and what it actually means to have experiences? </small> Consciousness as intentionally ordered information is a mirror that…
body:
> <small>The summary tries to answer the question: how consciousness works and what it actually means to have experiences? </small>

Consciousness as intentionally ordered information is a mirror that reflects what our senses tell us about what happens both outside our bodies and within the nervous system. It reflects those changes selectively, actively shaping events and imposing on them a reality of its own. Consciousness has developed the ability to override its genetic instructions and to set its own independent course of action. We all know individuals who can transform hopeless situations into challenges to be overcome, just through the force of their personalities. This ability to persevere despite obstacles and setbacks is the quality people most admire in others, to develop this trait, one must find ways to order consciousness so as to be in control of feelings and thoughts.

Consciousness can be ordered in terms of different goals and intentions. Here intentions is the force that keeps information in consciousness ordered and doesn’t say why a person wants to do a certain thing, but simply states that he does.

Most people fall far below the peak capacity for processing information. Since an individual can experience only so much. Therefore, the information we allow into consciousness becomes extremely important; it is,in fact, what determines the content and the quality of life. The mark of a person who is in control of consciousness is the ability to focus attention at will,to be oblivious to distractions, to concentrate for as long as it takes to achieve a goal, and not longer. And the person who can do this usually enjoys the normal course of everyday life.

We create ourselves by how we invest the attention,which is our most important tool in the task of improving the quality of experience. Each person allocates his or her limited attention either by focusing it intentionally like a beam of energy or by diffusing it in desultory, random movements. The shape and content of life depend on how attention has been used. Entirely different realities will emerge depending on how it is invested. Author takes E. for example, E. disciplines her attention and refuses to diffuse it on unproductive thoughts or activities. At this point she radiates a pure glow of energy. And despite past hardships and the intensity of her present life, she seems to relish thoroughly every minute of it.

When attention can be freely invested to achieve a person’s goals, because there is no disorder to straighten out, no threat for the self to defend against,we call this state the flow experience. When one attains it develop a stronger, more confident self, because more of their psychic energy has been invested successfully in goals they themselves had chosen to pursue. When a person is able to organize his or her consciousness so as to experience flow as often as possible, the quality of life is inevitably going to improve, even the usually boring routines of work become purposeful and enjoyable. In flow we are in control of our psychic energy, and everything we do adds order to consciousness. One of the main forces that affects consciousness adversely is psychic disorder —–that is, information that conflicts with existing intentions, or distracts us from carrying them out. Whenever information disrupts consciousness by threatening its goals we have a condition of inner disorder, or psychic entropy, a disorganization of the self that impairs its effectiveness.If you win the battles, which is against the entropy that brings disorder to consciousness. It is really a battle for the self; it is a struggle for establishing control over attention. Anyone who has experienced flow knows that the deep enjoyment it provides requires an equal degree of disciplined concentration.

The self is in many ways the most important element of consciousness, for it represents symbolically all of consciousness’s other contents. Attention shapes the self, and is in turn shaped by it. Following a flow experience, the organization of the self is more complex that it had been before. It is by becoming increasingly complex that the self might be said to grow.Complexity is the result of two broad psychological processes: differentiation and integration. Differentiation implies a movement toward uniqueness, toward separating oneself from others. The self becomes more differentiated as a result of flow because overcoming a challenge inevitably leaves a person feeling more capable,more skilled. After each episode of flow a person becomes more of a unique individual, less predictable, prossessed of rarer skills. Complexity also involves the integration of autonomous parts. Flow helps to integrate the self because in that state of deep concentration consciousness is unusually well ordered.

When the flow episode is over, one feels more together than before, not only internally but also with respect to other people and to the world in general. The self becomes complex as a result of experiencing flow. It is when we act freely, for the sake of the action itself rather than for ulterior motives, that we learn to become more that what we were. When we choose a goal and invest ourselves in it to the limits of our concentration, whatever we do will be enjoyable. And once we have tasted this joy, we will redouble our efforts to taste it again. This is the way the self grows. Flow is important both because it makes the present instant more enjoyable and because it builds the self-confidence that allows us to develop skills and make significant contributions to humankind.

The third part will explore more thoroughly what we know about optimal experiences: How optimal experiences feel and under what conditions they occur?

body: #persons A colleague once remarked to me, as we were reviewing resumes: "Some people have 10 years of experience, some people have the same year of experience 10 times." The comment stuck with me. I try to put myself in roles and opportunities where I'm forced to level up constantly in order to do the job, and where I can't learn through first-hand experience, I read. I read a lot—about a hundred books a year—and I specifically seek out fiction that widens my understanding of the human experience and non-fiction that teaches me appreciation of different disciplines, from the personal (relationships, health, housecleaning) to the professional (sales, business, management) and everything else no matter how relevant or irrelevant to my life (anthropology, architecture, art). I work out (I'm a Peloton fanatic—cycling, treadmill, strength, yoga, all of it!). I read (every morning and every night). I cook (most days, most dinners). I spend time with friends and family (as much as I can, when I'm not recharging my introvert battery and keeping busy with everything else).

#poliitcs

对内- 听话； 对外- 让路

#insight
应该是自然渐进的过程, 通过政府力量推行只会“拔苗助长”

#insight
总把一些事情想得过于严重，就像第一次上台演讲，第一次考试失败，第一次失恋。回头看看，那些自己走过的路，遇到的人，摊上的事，其实也就那么回事。 

#insight #life
姥姥在世时常说：日子过得好不好，心里高不高兴，和成功、和钱、和别人日子好不好，都无关。人这一生，飞得多高，最后都得入地。惦量好自己的轻重，把手头事做好，把每一天扎实过，就是好日子

#insight
什么都在乎，就是不在乎自己是谁，活得像不像个人

body:
[AI Synthesis]: Praise and warmth raise self-esteem: thank often, smile with mood, and praise quickly, specifically, for large and small accomplishments.

Appreciation and thank-you
 Appreciation and praise are vitally important; people track how praiseworthy they feel.
 Say thank you on every occasion, large or small — make a habit of thanking everyone for everything they do.

Be quick to praise
 Praise elevates self-esteem.
 Be specific — a trait, possession, or accomplishment.
 Praise immediately.
 Praise both large and small accomplishments.
 Smiling and laughing is infectious — match the other person’s mood.

Actions
 Say “thank you” on every occasion, for any large or small reason.
 Praise people for something they have done; compliment a trait, possession, or accomplishment.
 Be quick, specific, and praise small wins as well as big ones.
 Match the other person’s mood with smile and laugh.

title: problem-solving-lead
excerpt: [AI Synthesis]: Take the lead without trying to control their reaction. Reframe blame into a learning conversation, embrace both stories with “and,” make trouble in the talk itself explicit, and seek…
excerpt_search: [AI Synthesis]: Take the lead without trying to control their reaction. Reframe blame into a learning conversation, embrace both stories with “and,” make trouble in the talk itself explicit, and seek…
body:
[AI Synthesis]: Take the lead without trying to control their reaction. Reframe blame into a learning conversation, embrace both stories with “and,” make trouble in the talk itself explicit, and seek fair standards or clear alternatives when you still disagree.

Raise it without controlling their reaction
 Raise it because it matters; do it as well as you can. If they aren’t interested or open, you can still feel good that you stuck up for yourself — you are not responsible for controlling their reaction.

Skills for leading
 Reframe from blame to a learning conversation:
   Truth → different stories: “I want to make sure I understand your perspective. I’d also like to share mine.”
   Accusations → intentions and impact: “It wasn’t my intention. Can you say more about how you felt?”
   Blame → joint contribution: “I’m sure I’ve contributed; I think we both have. Rather than whose fault, I’d like to look at how we got here.”
   Judgments → feelings: “It sounds like you’re feeling really unhappy with my behavior.”
   What’s wrong with you → what’s going on for you: “Whether we can work together to address both of our concerns.”
 Use “and” to embrace both stories instead of arguing whose version is true.
 Listen, ask questions, try to understand how they experience the issue.
 Make the trouble explicit: put on the table what you see happening in the conversation itself — “Here’s what I’m noticing.” “I really do want to know what’s upsetting you, and I want us to find a way to talk about it that…”

Compromise and standards
 Difficult conversations require compromise and mutual accommodation.
 Gather information and test perceptions; ask their advice; “Help me understand how you would feel if you were in my shoes.”
 Ask what standards should apply — fair principles to guide a resolution.
 If you still can’t agree, consider your alternatives: accept less than you want, or accept the consequences of not agreeing.

Actions
 Reframe live: different stories, intentions/impact, joint contribution, feelings.
 Name process trouble when the conversation itself is stuck.
 When stuck on substance, ask for fair standards; then weigh alternatives honestly.

 Make the trouble explicit: put on the table what you see happening in the conversation itself — “Here’s what I’m noticing.” “I really do want to know what’s upsetting you, and I want us to find a way to talk about it that…”

Compromise and standards
 Difficult conversations require compromise and mutual accommodation.
 Gather information and test perceptions; ask their advice; “Help me understand how you would feel if you were in my shoes.”
 Ask what standards should apply — fair principles to guide a resolution.
 If you still can’t agree, consider your alternatives: accept less than you want, or accept the consequences of not agreeing.

Actions
 Reframe live: different stories, intentions/impact, joint contribution, feelings.
 Name process trouble when the conversation itself is stuck.
 When stuck on substance, ask for fair standards; then weigh alternatives honestly.

body: #project-based 项目式学习是有一个目标 （可以是清楚的，也可以只有大概方向） - 学习的目的是达到目标，而途径可以不同 - 关键点 - 设定目标， 制定计划， 获取信息， 团队协作， 测量数据，分析总结， 演示结果 - 类似爵士乐， 允许演奏者随意发挥，同时要达到预期的效果 - 完善的计划， 足够的灵活， 一个可以开展团队协作的环境 #self 1. 工作， 尽可能快，尽可能高效      核心任務 - 至少用80%的时间 解決最重要，最困难的部分 - 不追求完美，只需要满足最小可行产品原则 (mini viable product) 2.  休闲， 以享乐主义的视角 - 尽可能享受当下的闲暇     体力活动 + 发展一项爱好，深度沉浸 3.  识别并规划更长收益的事情     - 锻炼身体     - 学习 “繁殖力”的知识     - 获得巅峰人生体验     - 从事写作等创造性活动     - 提升个人审美     - 反思与总结

title: psychological-games
excerpt: [AI Synthesis]: A psychological game is an ongoing series of complementary ulterior transactions progressing to a well-defined, dramatic payoff. People play for strokes, structure, and script confirm…
excerpt_search: [AI Synthesis]: A psychological game is an ongoing series of complementary ulterior transactions progressing to a well-defined, dramatic payoff. People play for strokes, structure, and script confirm…
body:
[AI Synthesis]: A psychological game is an ongoing series of complementary ulterior transactions progressing to a well-defined, dramatic payoff. People play for strokes, structure, and script confirmation; intimacy is rare and risky, so games fill most serious social life. The practical skill is knowing when to stop.

Definition
 A game is a recurring set of transactions, often repetitious, superficially plausible, with a concealed motivation—a series of moves with a snare or gimmick.
 Distinguished from procedures, rituals, and pastimes by (1) ulterior quality and (2) the payoff.
 Procedures, rituals, and pastimes are candid; every game is basically dishonest, and the ending is dramatic rather than merely exciting.
 "Game" and "play" do not imply fun; they can be grim or fatal (Alcoholic, War).

Why people play
 There is little opportunity for intimacy; intense intimacy is psychologically impossible for most people—so serious social life runs on games.
 Advantages: biological stroking, confirmation of existential position, internal and external psychological economy, structuring time with intimates and outsiders.
 Games are dynamic parts of an unconscious life-plan (script), filling time while advancing toward a constructive miracle or a destructive catastrophe.
 Some people's psychic stability depends on their games; stripping them away can plunge them into despair or psychosis—analyze with prudence.

Analysis grid
 Formal description uses: Thesis, Antithesis, Aim, Roles, Dynamics, childhood prototype, Transactional Paradigm (social vs psychological level), Moves, Advantages.
 Antithesis = refuse to play or undercut the payoff; "it" intensifies, then may fall into despair (Adult bewilderment—distinct from Child-led depression). Laughter is the opposite of despair.
 Degrees: first-degree (socially acceptable), second-degree (no permanent damage, but players prefer to hide it), third-degree (played for keeps—surgery, courtroom, or morgue).

Significance
 Historical: games pass generation to generation.
 Cultural: raising children is largely teaching them which games to play.
 Social: sandwiched between pastimes and intimacy—compromise when intimacy feels dangerous.
 Personal: people choose friends who play the same games; changing games risks extrusion from one circle and welcome in another.

Player types
 In any game, professionals know when to quit; amateurs do not.
 The sulker is someone angry at mother—Parent/Child material kept in play rather than resolved.
 The "weirdo" is overly sensitive to Parent ego-state influence—social oddness as a defense against scripted norms.

Thesaurus (sketch)
 Life: Alcoholic, Debtor, Kick Me, NIGYSOB, See What You Made Me Do.
 Marital: Corner, Courtroom, If It Weren't for You, Look How Hard I've Tried, and others.
 Party: Ain't It Awful, Blemish, Schlemiel, Why Don't You – Yes But.
 Also sexual, underworld, consulting-room, and a few "good" games.

Actions
 When a recurring argument or mood loop feels familiar, ask what game is running and what payoff each side is collecting.
 Practice stopping earlier than the script demands—treat quitting as skill, not defeat.
 Test an antithesis once: refuse the usual move or undercut the payoff; notice intensification, then despair or laughter.
 Do not strip someone's stabilizing game without a safer intimacy or Adult substitute available.

|--------|----------|------|

| notes/2026-08-27-games-people-play.md | 5 · 遊戲; 心理遊戲辭典; 13 · 遊戲的意義; 14 · 所謂玩家 | highlights |

title: psychology-of-money
excerpt: [AI Synthesis]: Morgan Housel’s The Psychology of Money treats money as behavior, not spreadsheets. Personal history and ego shape financial decisions more than formulas; the wiki themes below distil…
excerpt_search: [AI Synthesis]: Morgan Housel’s The Psychology of Money treats money as behavior, not spreadsheets. Personal history and ego shape financial decisions more than formulas; the wiki themes below distil…
body:
[AI Synthesis]: Morgan Housel’s The Psychology of Money treats money as behavior, not spreadsheets. Personal history and ego shape financial decisions more than formulas; the wiki themes below distill recurring patterns from the book.

Personal experience shapes financial worldview
 What you have lived through is more compelling than what you learn secondhand.
 Personal experiences with money may make up roughly 80% of how you think the world works.

Luck, humility, and the big picture
 Find humility when things go right; forgiveness and compassion when they go wrong.
 It is never as good or as bad as it looks. The world is big and complex; luck and risk are both real and hard to identify.
 Respect the power of luck and risk to focus on what you can actually control.

Less ego, more wealth
 Saving is the gap between your ego and your income; wealth is what you do not see.
 Wealth is created by suppressing what you could buy today to have more stuff or options in the future.

Universal guideposts
 “Does this help me sleep at night?” is the best universal guidepost for financial decisions.
 Respect the mess: people have vastly different goals. There is no single right answer—only the answer that works for you.

User trading lens (from note)
 [AI Synthesis]: FX is relative supply and relative rates—look for structural weaknesses or intent where authorities must (or want to) move the exchange rate, then express the view with leverage.
 Stock prices reflect discounted expected cash flows.

Actions
 Before major decisions, ask whether the choice helps you sleep at night.
 When outcomes look extreme, zoom out to luck, risk, and broad patterns—not just the case in front of you.

> <font color="#800080">桑德伯格认同谷歌的使命， 并且不计较职位，于是得到了这个机会。 </font>

> <font color="#800080">未来属于仍然愿意弄脏双手的人。 不要再时时怀念那些逝去的“优越感”。 </font>

> <font color="#800080"><small>不要把好的学校挂在嘴边,那只是第一份工作的敲门砖</small></font> 

> <font color="#800080"><small>唯一能让你真正保持生机的办法，就是深入挖掘你痴迷的东西</small></font>  

> <small>传统中国重视思想却不重视理论，而且不重视逻辑训练 </small>

> <font color="#800080"><small>知道怎么站在别人的角度思考问题，这是最重要的； </font>外交的艺术就是把你的愿望变成别人的愿望</small>   

> <font color="#800080"><small>可以选择善良，但要有应对复杂的能力</font> </small> 

> <small>年轻时花精力投入在自我成长上，到某个阶段，<font color="#800080">专业的力量会散发出一种独特魅力</font> </small>  

> <small>念书的唯一目的就是知识，知识与所得财富有正相关；知识与商业报酬之间没有必然联系 </small> 

> <small><font color="#800080">庆祝每一次胜利，很自豪我做过的那些事</font> </small> 

> <small><font color="#800080">观察他人是如何生活的</font>，结识来自各个收入水平的人群，并<font color="#800080">尝试去理解他们的世界</font>  </small>

> <small>人若是心灵成熟，或是心智继续成长，就能与人讨论任何事情而不会引人生厌<font color="#800080">凡是经由他处理的每件事，都会变的有意义</font>  </small>

> <small>直面未来生活的各种变故与不确定性，更好地与自己所生活的世界打交道；理解它的复杂性，以及自己在其中扮演的角色，从而拥有一个更美好和富有意义的人生  </small>

> <small>沟通的关键是认知差异； 信任是 了解对方的核心诉求，极力维持</small>  

> <small>有深入的跨国体验  </small>

>  <small><font color="#800080">男人能力一直在和责任赛跑；有些情况下，被残酷地赋予很难的责任，那也只能硬着头皮继续成长；</font> 另一种就是能力增长，视野开阔了，会主动招揽一些责任，使命感； 两者并存   </small>

>  <small><font color="#800080">一个人不断进步的结果是遇到越来越精彩和优秀的人，你知道他／她真的很优秀，从外在到内心。</font>
就因为你变得优秀，你会遇到更优秀的人。 优秀是一种信息素，随风飘散。 <font color="#800080"></small>为遇到这些更优秀的人而进步吧，不要停止</font>。  

> <small><font color="#800080">在自己喜欢的人身上用心，在不喜欢自己的人身上健忘</font></small>

> <small><font color="#800080">社交能力；知道怎么站在别人的角度思考问题； 尝试理解对方的需求；人际关系的本质是 了解和应对别人的需求； </font> 有一个高质量的朋友圈（价值观一致，有一些相同的爱好，在一起说话，最好有趣一些）</small>

> <small><font color="#800080">该讲法律的地方不要强调道德</font></small>

><small><font color="#800080">继续展示自己的技术水平和经营自己的人脉的好处依然是，机会随时可能降临。</font></small>

> <small>老板的角度都是，<font color="#800080">他们能给我们什么？我们是否有这个责任一定要确实完成这些要求？ </font></small>

> <small>真想最大的敌人不是谎言而是<font color="#800080">信念</font> - 尼采</small>

> <small>怀疑的精神特别重要，就是尽量不要去人云亦云； <font color="#800080">自己去看了，自己有所体会了，再下这样的论断 </font>; 关注事实胜过关注争吵，关心细节胜过关心策略</small>

> <small>“斤斤计较”的权利意识, 更是生动注释了美国人“权利观念”胜于“敌我观念”之精神; 另外，美国社会的“公民责任意识” ；
“当我的权益受到侵害，你要坚决捍卫我的权益；当你的权益受到侵害时，我要坚决捍卫你的权益”的责任共同体意识；</small>

当人们普遍缺乏“规则意识”、“责任意识”时，制度要么形同虚设，要么就意味着大到惊人的实施成本

> <small> 人性 - 对他人的真心关怀，追求双赢

body:
[AI Synthesis]: Perfect rationality is a poor guide for real humans. Reasonable plans you can stick with beat optimal plans you abandon.

Reasonable beats coldly rational
 Do not aim to be coldly rational when making financial decisions.
 Aim to be pretty reasonable—more realistic and easier to sustain for the long run.
 That is where the science ends and reality takes over.

Actions
 Prefer a financial rule you will follow for decades over a theoretically optimal rule you will quit under stress.

body: #relationships #self #education 1. 没有人应该是完美的 - 期望孩子完美， 指出他们的不足，希望他们改正和进步 我们都是普通人， 所以从小到大每取得一点成就 都让家人为他骄傲 2. 把对方做为一个独立的生命去尊重，对孩子每一点点的努力感动和欣慰 从对方的成长中学习体会和反思，努力提高自己，和对方一起进步 - 不会去评判对方，只是平等地和对方探讨事情 - 比如我仅仅是告诉对方我怎么做，为什么这么做，对方自然知道她可以按照我的去做，也可以按照自己的想法做， 如果她的做法比我更合理有效，我就会向她学习 1. 自信是 坚信自己有能力面对自己的不足，有能力解决问题 - 成长 - 成长的过程就象学走路，摔倒了不是错误，不是失败，而是进步的过程 学会关注自己的进步 和行动的前因后果 - 试错的机会，成长的机会 - 也不是坚信自己做的想的一切都合理 - 有了这样的自信，就不怕把自己的问题展现出来，就能够坦然面对，冷静解决 - 有了这样的自信，就会 认真虔诚地向别人学习 - 自信的家人会坦然面对自己的孩子，也不会因他们而丢面子 - 每一点点进步，都看到了父母的惊喜和赞赏 通过一个个小成功走过来进步更快

body:
[AI Synthesis]: Stoics advocate for indifference toward external reputation, as it is a factor outside our direct control. True freedom is found in self-knowledge and living according to one's own values rather than the approval of others.

不在意他人看法
   不要在意別人對我們的看法，這與不專注在「無法控制的事物」的忠告相吻合。
   為了贏得他人的接納而放棄夢想是不值得的。

恐懼與失敗
對失敗的恐懼往往源自於害怕他人的看法。

真實自我
人只有真正知道自己是誰，才會表現出對名聲的不在意。

body:
[AI Synthesis]: Margin of safety is not only mathematical—it is emotional. Endurance lets compounding work; barbells and gaps between possible and required outcomes buy that endurance.

Use room for error in forecasts
 Use room for error when estimating future returns.
 Having a gap between what you can technically endure versus what is emotionally possible is an overlooked form of room for error.

Barbell your own money
 Take risks with one portion and be terrified with the other.
 Stay standing long enough for risks to pay off—you have to survive to succeed.
 The ability to do what you want, when you want, for as long as you want has an infinite ROI.
 With no savings, you cannot create a gap between expected expenses and what they might become.

No greater force in finance
 There is no greater force in finance than room for error; the higher the stakes, the wider it should be.
 Worship room for error: a gap between what could happen and what you need to happen is what gives endurance—and endurance makes compounding magic over time.

Balance and changing minds
 Save for things you cannot predict or even comprehend.
 Avoid the extreme ends of financial planning.
 Balance at every point in life becomes a strategy to avoid future regret and encourage endurance when you accept that you will change.
 Accept the reality of changing your mind.
 Avoid the extreme ends of financial decisions.

Actions
 Size risky bets so failure does not end the game; keep a terrified reserve in cash or safe assets.
 When stakes rise, widen margins in assumptions, liquidity, and emotional tolerance—not only in models.

excerpt: [AI Synthesis]: Savings rate beats income for many people past a modest lifestyle. Humility and indifference to others’ opinions widen the gap between ego and spending. Savings rate and efficiency A…

body:
[AI Synthesis]: Savings rate beats income for many people past a modest lifestyle. Humility and indifference to others’ opinions widen the gap between ego and spending.

Savings rate and efficiency
 A lot depends on your savings rate—not only on earning more.
 Becoming more efficient with the energy you use is largely in your control.
 If you view wealth-building as powered by your own frugality and efficiency, the path is clearer.
 The value of wealth is relative to what you need.

Happiness with less
 Learning to be happy with less money creates a gap between what you have and what you want.
 A high savings rate means having lower expenses than you otherwise could.
 Past a certain income level, what you need sits below what your ego demands.

Ego, income, and humility
 When you define savings as the gap between your ego and your income:
   Spending beyond a modest level of materialism mostly reflects ego approaching income—a way to show people you have money.
   One of the most powerful ways to increase savings is not to raise income but to raise humility.
   People with enduring personal-finance success tend not to care what others think of them.

Psychology over spreadsheets
 Money relies more on psychology than finance.
 Savings can be created by spending less; you spend less if you desire less; you desire less if you care less about others’ opinions.
 Competitive advantages tilt toward soft skills—communication, empathy, and especially flexibility.
 Flexibility helps you stay relevant in a fast-moving world.
 More control over your time and options is becoming one of the most valuable currencies.

Just save
 You do not need a specific reason to save.

Actions
 Raise savings by lowering ego-driven spending, not only by chasing higher income.
 Practice caring less about visible status signals that inflate “needs.”

body: #science 什么是神学？就是面对表盘，将表针运动归因于神灵拨动的各种学说。 什么是唯心主义哲学？就是面对表盘，将表针运动归因于人的心在动的各种学说。 什么是古代科学？就是面对表盘，但部分或全部排除了神灵，将表针运动归因于某种客观规律并想象出一些理论解释的各种学说。 最后，什么是现代科学？就是 1. 科学精神：观察 - 想到并敢于打开手表的后盖观察内部； <- dare to know 2.科学思维：假设 - 提出各种关于内部机械原理的理论假设； 3.科学方法：实验 - 观察内部机械装置，精确测量机械运动，与头脑中的理论假设进行对照； 4.科学进步：推翻以前的理论并提出新的假设，通过重复3和4，使理论与实际两者之间不断逼近一致。 尤瓦尔•赫拉利在《人类简史》一书中总结了现代科学区别于古代知识体系的三大独特性：1. 愿意承认自己的无知；2. 以观察和数学为中心；3. 取得新能力。 #science 1. 对现象的感知 - 旅游 2. 提出质疑 - 要经过自己研究，自己搞懂的结论 - 不要迷信权威和权威的结论 3. 小心求证 - 充分研究，分析和总结工作 - “大胆假设，小心求证” 4. 对于复杂的问题， 分解为小问题来解决 - divide and conquer 5. 从问题出发，通过实验得到结果之后，需要合理地解释结果， 并从一般性的结果上升到结论， 最后将结论推广并普遍化 - 从有限经验得到的结论被推广之后，又会出现新的问题，新的解释不了的现象，这就形成了新问题 #research #science 亚里士多德“演绎推理”的“归纳推理” 如何观测和理解手表内部整套机械装置的方法： 运用人的理性，仅仅盯住基本事实，对大量新经验进行组织和归纳，从中推导出公理，无论这些公理是什么都要接受 #insight 真实的历史告诉人们，由于秩序感和运动感是人类从自然界中得到的两种最强烈的感觉经验，所以人类文明的发展一直是秩序主义和运动主义两方面的平衡。 "天下“秩序，那种不顾一切去翻转表盘、掀开后盖的运动主义冲动，永远不可能自发产生。 一种向前看的、行进中的世界观终于取代了过去数千年没变过的停滞的或循环的世界观

body: #science 什么是神学？就是面对表盘，将表针运动归因于神灵拨动的各种学说。 什么是唯心主义哲学？就是面对表盘，将表针运动归因于人的心在动的各种学说。 什么是古代科学？就是面对表盘，但部分或全部排除了神灵，将表针运动归因于某种客观规律并想象出一些理论解释的各种学说。 最后，什么是现代科学？就是 1. 科学精神：观察 - 想到并敢于打开手表的后盖观察内部； <- dare to know 2.科学思维：假设 - 提出各种关于内部机械原理的理论假设； 3.科学方法：实验 - 观察内部机械装置，精确测量机械运动，与头脑中的理论假设进行对照； 4.科学进步：推翻以前的理论并提出新的假设，通过重复3和4，使理论与实际两者之间不断逼近一致。 尤瓦尔•赫拉利在《人类简史》一书中总结了现代科学区别于古代知识体系的三大独特性：1. 愿意承认自己的无知；2. 以观察和数学为中心；3. 取得新能力。 #science 1. 对现象的感知 - 旅游 2. 提出质疑 - 要经过自己研究，自己搞懂的结论 - 不要迷信权威和权威的结论 3. 小心求证 - 充分研究，分析和总结工作 - “大胆假设，小心求证” 4. 对于复杂的问题， 分解为小问题来解决 - divide and conquer 5. 从问题出发，通过实验得到结果之后，需要合理地解释结果， 并从一般性的结果上升到结论， 最后将结论推广并普遍化 - 从有限经验得到的结论被推广之后，又会出现新的问题，新的解释不了的现象，这就形成了新问题 #research #science 亚里士多德“演绎推理”的“归纳推理” 如何观测和理解手表内部整套机械装置的方法： 运用人的理性，仅仅盯住基本事实，对大量新经验进行组织和归纳，从中推导出公理，无论这些公理是什么都要接受 #insight 真实的历史告诉人们，由于秩序感和运动感是人类从自然界中得到的两种最强烈的感觉经验，所以人类文明的发展一直是秩序主义和运动主义两方面的平衡。 "天下“秩序，那种不顾一切去翻转表盘、掀开后盖的运动主义冲动，永远不可能自发产生。 一种向前看的、行进中的世界观终于取代了过去数千年没变过的停滞的或循环的世界观

body:
#science #important 

I have a friend who’s an artist and has sometimes taken a view which I don’t agree with very well. He’ll hold up a flower and say “look how beautiful it is,” and I’ll agree. Then he says “I as an artist can see how beautiful this is but you as a scientist take this all apart and it becomes a dull thing,” and I think that he’s kind of nutty. First of all, the beauty that he sees is available to other people and to me too, I believe…

I can appreciate the beauty of a flower. At the same time, I see much more about the flower than he sees. I could imagine the cells in there, the complicated actions inside, which also have a beauty. I mean it’s not just beauty at this dimension, at one centimeter; there’s also beauty at smaller dimensions, the inner structure, also the processes. The fact that the colors in the flower evolved in order to attract insects to pollinate it is interesting; it means that insects can see the color. It adds a question: does this aesthetic sense also exist in the lower forms? Why is it aesthetic? All kinds of interesting questions which the science knowledge only adds to the excitement, the mystery and the awe of a flower. It only adds. I don’t understand how it subtracts.

body:
[AI Synthesis]: Pessimism sounds smart and spreads fast; optimism is often right over time. Progress compounds slowly; setbacks arrive suddenly.

Why pessimism seduces
 Pessimism sounds smarter and more plausible than optimism.
 Money is ubiquitous—everyone has opinions—so pessimistic takes get amplified.
 Pessimists often extrapolate present trends without accounting for how markets adapt.
 Necessity is the mother of invention; adaptation makes many scary forecasts less frightening than they sound.
 Assuming something ugly will stay ugly is an easy, persuasive forecast because it does not require imagining change.

Progress vs setbacks
 Progress happens too slowly to notice; setbacks happen too quickly to ignore.
 Growth is driven by compounding, which takes time.
 Destruction is driven by single points of failure (seconds) and loss of confidence (instant).

Pessimism narrows expectations
 Pessimism reduces expectations, narrowing the gap between possible outcomes and outcomes you feel great about.

Actions
 When a doom narrative feels especially convincing, ask what adaptation or invention it assumes cannot happen.

body: #self 不好意思讲 自己想要什么？ 不好意思把自己的意图或目标说清楚 “防御性社交” 与 评价焦虑 - 潜意识里将“表达需求” 等同于 “向对方索取” 或 “对他人造成负担” - 心理偏差： 这种心理源于一种隐形的“评价焦虑” 担心一旦目标被明确，如果结果不如预期，或者需求被拒绝， 你的“专业形象” 或 “人格特质” 会被对方重新定义 - 事实层面： 在高效沟通中， 意图是降低协作成本的最佳工具。 模糊的意图反而会让对方猜测，增加对方的认知负荷， 这在专业语境下其实是更“不礼貌”的行为 对“权力博弈”的误读 - 将“表达需求” 视为一种权力的让渡 - 心理偏差： 担心说出想要什么，会让自己处于“被选择” 或“被动” 位置， 或者 觉得如果表达了意图，就失去了某种掌控感 - 事实层面： 在职场与高端社交中， 清晰的界限与明确的议程 是掌握主导权的体现。 能够坦率表达意图的人， 往往能过滤掉低效的沟通， 吸引到能够提供对等交换的伙伴 - 对方会看这个人的“清晰度”和“可预期性” - 把“不好意思” 转化为“请求建议” - “我最近在规划， 如果换做你，你会如何解决” 习惯“利他便好”补偿 - 自己习惯于通过解决问题（而非直接交换价值） 来获得他人认可 - 心理偏差： 长期通过“润物细无声”的方式工作， 成让你Chens一种心理预期 - 事实层面： 职场中专业关系不是基于默契，而是基于 契约与预期管理。 你的意图不表达， 对方的预期就会产生偏差， 导致最终交付与你的真实诉求错位 重构对“表达意图” 的定义 - 从“乞求” 转向 “协议” - 视角转换 + 不要把说出目标看作是“向人索取”， 而应将其视为“降低对方的决策成本”。 告诉对方你想要什么， 是你在帮助对方更高效地与你协作 - 使用”条件化表达“ 而非 ”情绪化表达“ + 错误 ”我不太好意思麻烦你， 但我其实很想要 …“ （这是自我贬低） + 客观示例： “为了实现【项目目标】，我目前的优先级是【x】，需要你在【y】方面配合， 你评估一下这是否在我们的协作范围内？” + 建立“职业化”： 剥离个人情绪色彩

body: #self #relationship Don’t worry about what people think about you: they don’t. No one cares about your opinion until you are either rich, influential, or very talented. Be kind & loving, but smart. Just Focus on relationships with high-principled, driven, happy people If you think people always reciprocate what you do for them, you haven't met enough people. Some even attempt to backstab you out of resentfulness, because you "make them feel bad." #todo Build a personalized system that's in sync with your nature. Stop looking for the best deal you can get, and start looking for someone you like enough and trust enough to build a life with - and stick with them Confidence leads to decisiveness. An indecisive men is useless. Asking for feedback all the time is the best way to stay grounded in reality build your knowledge, network, body, and a non-job cash flow source. Literally everything else solves itself if you have freedom, health, and judgement sorted out. #love A woman should never submit to a man she doesn’t trust implicitly to make decisions that are in the best interest of his family. If she doesn’t trust or have confidence in him, she doesn’t respect him, and therefore, shouldn’t be with him. #self "Being attractive" is mostly about: - being driven by noble purposes - optimizing your diet and habits - being clear-minded, calm, smart - being kind, relaxed, happy Trust yourself - In your ability to succeed at anything you do. - In your ability to pick yourself back up if you fail. - In your ability to continue the journey through the inevitable ups and downs.

Self-Hypotheses

This file stores user-judged hypotheses about the self. Full query answers remain in self-wiki/outputs/; this file keeps accepted, revised, rejected, and uncertain judgments.

人格底色： 具有高度自我反思能力的理智現實主義者  Reflective Rational Realist  
 你的人格內核  
    - 一個渴望通過邏輯掌控秩序，卻在本質上追求深層連結的“探險家”  
    - 你用一套極具智識的邏輯架構把自己武裝起來（殼）， 但你的內核其實極其渴求溫暖和親密（核）  
        + 承認你的“防禦機制”： 當你感覺受到威脅或不安時，你傾向於通過復盤，分析來重獲控制感；
        下一次，嘗試直接承認： “我感到有點不安”， 這比你寫出一百條邏輯復盤更能打動人心  
        + 在家人和愛面前，學會放下“建設者”身分，做一個單純的“陪伴者”  

    
 核心人格特质： 系统性思维 Systemic Mindset   
    - 試圖通過建立模型來理解世界  
        - 在關係中的體現： 傾向於把關係也看作一個“系統”。 你追求關係的穩固，迭代和優化  
        - 優勢： 你及其理智，在關係出現危機時，你不會陷入歇斯底里的情緒，而是能冷靜復盤  
        - 挑戰： 系統化有時讓你顯得過於”工具化“。  
        需要意識到， 有時候邏輯上的”最優解“並不等於情感上的”最佳解“  

    - 情緒底色： 深層的不安全感與控制需求  
        - 對”可控性“的渴求。 希望通過不斷優化自己，去”贏得“你想要的結果
             - 在關係中： 你非常看重可靠性。 害怕失控  
             - 優勢： 這讓你成為一個非常自律且負責任的人  
             - 挑戰： 愛和信任，往往發生在”不可控“的地方。 
             如果太想控制關係，反而因為用力過猛而導致對方產生壓力  
    
    - 社交風格： 高智識門檻的”連接者“  
        - 在關係中： 你不追求”點頭之交“， 你追求的是深度的對話  
        - 優勢： 你的朋友質量極高，你對關係的投入是高質量的  
        - 挑戰： 這種高要求會讓你面對普通人，因為他們可能無法像你一樣處理深度邏輯  

    - 性格中的”冰與火“： 邏輯的冰冷與渴望溫情的火   
        - 你用機器冷峻的邏輯（冰）在構築你的生活，
        但你的內心（火） 卻在通過你的行為渴求深層連結。  
        - 你不是一個冷漠的人，你只是缺乏一種‘安全展示溫情”的途徑  

    - 建議： 如何利用這種人格去建設關係？
        - 在家庭/親密關係時，放棄“修復”模式
            - 家庭中，很多時候，對方需要的不是“解決方案”， 而是你的“看見”和“在場”  
            - 試著把“解決問題” 替換成 “共情回應”  

        - 利用“真實” 作為破冰武器  
            - 你的人格中最缺乏的可能是 “適度的脆弱”  
            - 既然你是一個對自己要求很高的理智者，偶爾向你在乎的人展示你的不確定，你的壓力，
            這反而會讓你的人格顯得更加豐滿  

        - 對朋友保持“成長性連結”  
            - 你不僅是在交朋友，你是在尋找同路人。
            請繼續保持這種篩選，因為和你人格匹配的人，會是你生命中極其珍貴的資產

Distillation (2026-06-16) - source: raw/origin-apple-notes/softskills  china.md
In Chinese cultural consciousness, '争表现' can leave independent thought and self-worth separated from parental/teacher validation underdeveloped. True adulthood—with self-respect and dignity—requires an established personal code and respect from others. Socially: emotional resonance for close friends, rational instrumentality for strangers and tasks; personality controlled rationally for goals, expressed emotionally with intimates. (Source: raw/origin-apple-notes/softskills  china.md)

2011 psychological self-analysis (perfectionism → growth):

- Fear of failure / must-be-perfect → delay to avoid judgment; beliefs: mediocrity invites contempt; can't bear losing; all-or-nothing.
- Growth mindset: ability develops; failure ≠ worth; success = 及时追随目标; others' judgment can guide improvement.
- Independence: control/rights over exposure; world-as-battlefield (ranking culture); ask "我这样的反应针对的是什么？" — request ≠ control; cooperation can be joyful.
- Comfort zone: fear of closeness (energy/responsibility); good relationships balance dependence and independence.

- (Source: raw/posts/diary/2011-01-29.diary.md)

- 盲点：没结婚→父母失望→自己不够「完整」→无条件接纳动摇；会把女方当个人价值证明。建立心里边界；接纳首先来自自己；每周几小时为「自己的快乐」而活。
- 完整也含可隐藏的阴影（恐惧、嫉妒、防御、创伤反应）——敢于承认并整合。
- 激进诚实：记录感受（微小恐惧/耻辱）；区分行动 vs 存在；承认「我现在很迷茫」本身是真实与强大。
- 人格内核：渴望通过逻辑掌控秩序，本质追求深层连结的探险家；动力=展示价值换取接纳（「只有足够好才配被爱」）；社交追求智识同频。
- 工具化：警惕关系过拟合/算法思维；不安时直接说「我感到有点不安」；家人爱人面前放下建设者，做陪伴者。
- (Source: raw/posts/new-apple-notes/2026-06-20.md)

- 价值在于「你这个人」：智性好奇 the seeker；对连结的渴望 the connector；对掌控的追求 the controller（对抗不确定性焦虑）；好奇心、深度、成长心态、专注、诚实。

- 盲点：过度追求效率与正确性 → 无法容忍非理性情绪或无效率休息 → 严苛批判摧毁内在自信；最高境界是与不可控性共存。
- 厚面皮：理得你怎么看；识兜（懂得处理）；最重要撑自己；足够能力与 self-believe；不 care 有无朋友、人地钟不钟意你。
- (Source: raw/posts/new-apple-notes/2026-06-28.md)

- 盲點：沒結婚→父母失望→自己不夠「完整」→無條件接納動搖；會把女方當個人價值證明。建立心裏邊界；接納首先來自自己；每週幾小時爲「自己的快樂」而活。
- 完整也含可隱藏的陰影（恐懼、嫉妒、防禦、創傷反應）——敢於承認並整合。
- 激進誠實：記錄感受（微小恐懼/恥辱）；區分行動 vs 存在；承認「我現在很迷茫」本身是真實與強大。

- 工具化：警惕關係過擬合/算法思維；不安時直接說「我感到有點不安」；家人愛人面前放下建設者，做陪伴者。
- (Source: raw/posts/new-apple-notes/2026-06-20.md)

Distillation (2026-07-09) - source: raw/posts/new-apple-notes/2026-06-28.md
價值在人與真正自信（2026-06-28）：
- 價值在於「你這個人」：智性好奇 the seeker；對連結的渴望 the connector；對掌控的追求 the controller（對抗不確定性焦慮）；好奇心、深度、成長心態、專注、誠實。
- 真正自信：對應對未知與失敗的能力抱有深層信任——Self-Efficacy / Self-Acceptance / Courage to Act（不確定中仍邁步）。
- 盲點：過度追求效率與正確性 → 無法容忍非理性情緒或無效率休息 → 嚴苛批判摧毀內在自信；最高境界是與不可控性共存。
- 厚麪皮：理得你怎麼看；識兜（懂得處理）；最重要撐自己；足夠能力與 self-believe；不 care 有無朋友、人地鐘不鐘意你。
- (Source: raw/posts/new-apple-notes/2026-06-28.md)

body:
about 'Self-Wiki' 
"Know thyself" is so hard, while most of time we rely on feedbacks around coachers or friends. Now we can use an AI agent for it, based on personal entries. By moving from a "Knowledge Queries" to a "Socratic Mirror", the agent acts as a mirror, reflecting and expanding our thought to foster self-awareness, emotional regulaton, and deeper cognitive engagement.

Unlike traditional AI that provides answers, the Socratic Mirror, as discussed in Psychology Today, is designed to understand ones own limitations, unconscious, character, motivations, and insights. 

The agent incrementally builds and maintains a persistent and compounding wiki automatically. When one adds any new source even each query, the agent will integrates these into the existing wiki so that a structured picture of oneself is given over time. An evolving 'Self-Wiki' by the agent then could used be for psychological integration.  

The 'Self-Wiki' also can be on coaching and education service.  

Project structure  
The structure is as follows:

self-wiki/  
├── raw/ (input dump)  
├── wiki/ (AI-organized knowledge base)  
├── outputs/ (AI-generated answers)  
└── AGENTS.md (operating instructions for the AI)  

See dev.self-wiki repo for more details.

reference
 karpathy llm-wiki  
 卡爾帕維尼·榮格

> Raw-only proprietary-facts snapshot. Claims are valid only with verbatim cites from raw/. Not a wiki principle page.

Question

show me my startup ideas

Answer

show me my startup ideas

> The Evidence Pack does not contain a list of your specific personal startup ideas; however, it provides numerous frameworks, methods, and advice for generating and selecting them.

Answer

The provided evidence focuses on how to find and evaluate startup ideas rather than listing specific ideas:

   Methods for Generating Ideas [AI Synthesis]:
       Direct Experience: Starting a startup can reveal needs and problems you didn't know existed (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-021.md · #p44 · L117–L117 > "There's nothing like starting a startup to give you startup ideas. You discover all kinds of needs you didn't know existed."). [Twitter Reference]
       Domain Expertise: Having deep expertise in a domain or importing insights from one domain to another (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-032.md · #p754 · L2239–L2239 > "To get startup ideas, it's necessary to have fairly deep expertise in some domain. The idea is usually in the same domain, but it doesn't have to be. A startup idea can also consist of importing insights from one domain to another."). [Twitter Reference]
       Financial Utility: Creating something that helps peers make money (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-034.md · #p433 · L1250–L1250 > "one way to get ideas is to ask if there's something you could create that would help your peers to make money."). [Twitter Reference]
       Curiosity and Exploration: Leading an interesting life, being curious, and exploring random topics (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-044.md · #p938 · L2654–L2654 > "The best way to come up with startup ideas is to lead an interesting life & be curious.") and (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-012.md · #p19 · L55–L55 > "Exploring random topics, driven by your own curiosity, is the most valuable form of learning. This is where the real outlier ideas come from."). [Twitter Reference]
       Volume and Iteration: Generating a large quantity of ideas, including bad ones, to separate the good from the bad (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-046.md · #p233 · L698–L698 > "If you want to have good ideas, you need to have a lot of ideas, and that means you need to have a lot of bad ideas."). [Twitter Reference]
       Competitive Analysis: Borrowing concepts and ideas from other startups (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-046.md · #p1018 · L2975–L2975 > "You can always borrow concepts and ideas from other startups, too."). [Twitter Reference]

   Current Opportunities [AI Synthesis]:
       AI is noted as the "biggest opportunity," while non-AI ideas are described as the "most underpriced opportunity" (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-009.md · #p1331 · L3865–L3865 > "The biggest opportunity for would-be startup founders is AI. But the most underpriced opportunity is probably non-AI ideas."). [Twitter Reference]

   Criteria for Picking Ideas [AI Synthesis]:
       Ideas should fit the founding team's strengths, be something the founder cares about enough to persevere through lows, and focus on big customer needs (Source: raw/twitter/twitter-likes-045.md · #p900 · L2506–L2509 > "find an idea that fits the founding team's strengths\n- you must care enough about it to persevere through lows\n- focus on big customer needs").
